title: Autonomous Driving Systems Simulation and Data Analysis Engineer
description:
Company Description


CS Group Canada, a subsidiary of CS Group (part of the Sopra Steria Group), is a leader in the development and certification of safety-critical systems in the aerospace, electric, and autonomous driving industries.


CS Group Canada, a subsidiary of CS Group (part of the Sopra Steria Group), is a leader in the development and certification of safety-critical systems in the aerospace, electric, and autonomous driving industries.


Joining CS Group Canada means taking part in complex, high-tech projects for some of the most prestigious system manufacturers in North America, while benefiting from competitive salaries, comprehensive benefits, and flexible work arrangements.



Job Description


Support the validation and continuous refinement of performance requirements, safety thresholds, and key performance indicators (KPIs) for autonomous driving systems through large-scale simulation and real-world data analysis.


The engineer will leverage simulation, data analytics, and software development to quantify and refine performance, behavioral, and technical requirements necessary to achieve system safety. The role focuses on safety requirements quantification, including latency budgets, safety mechanism thresholds, and checker maturation parameters, while developing and maintaining simulation and analysis tools, and supporting scalable safety validation activities.



Key Responsibilities



Simulation Development & Scenario Execution



  • Develop and maintain simulation tooling in C/C++ and Python to support large-scale autonomous driving validation activities.

  • Design interfaces and integrations between internal validation tools, simulation environments, and data processing frameworks.

  • Extend existing simulation scenarios to inject perception noise, latency, and failure conditions to characterize system robustness.

  • Support containerized development and deployment environments using Docker and Linux-based infrastructure.

  • Use simulation results to support the definition and refinement of subsystem performance requirements and safety thresholds.

  • Evaluate the effectiveness of safety mechanisms under degraded system performance conditions.



Data Analytics & Performance Evaluation



  • Develop and maintain Python- and C/C++-based analysis and simulation pipelines to process, visualize, and evaluate large-scale driving and simulation datasets.

  • Investigate scenarios where unsafe behavior occurs despite performance targets being met and provide data-driven recommendations for improving metrics, thresholds, or requirements.

  • Determine characterization data and quantify system performance against KPIs, SPIs, safety targets, and behavior requirements.



Qualifications



Education



  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Computer Science, or a related discipline.



Experience



  • Experience with validating and quantifying performance criteria for autonomous driving functions such as:


    • Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC)

    • Lane Centering

    • Automated Lane Change

    • Highway Driving Assist

    • Automated Driving / ADS functions


  • Experience analyzing autonomous driving datasets and vehicle performance data.

  • Experience developing production-quality software in C/C++ and/or Python, including tool development, automation, and system integration activities.

  • Experience with Linux-based development environments.

  • Experience integrating software applications into CI/CD pipelines and automated validation workflows.

  • Experience working with autonomous driving software stacks, particularly:


    • Perception

    • Object tracking/fusion

    • Vehicle Intent

    • Prediction

    • Planning

    • Vehicle control interfaces


  • Experience evaluating software and system performance using simulation and real-world validation data.



Desired Skills



Simulation & Scenario-Based Validation



  • Experience with Applied Intuition Simian simulation environments.

  • Experience with Foretellix scenario generation and validation tools.

  • Experience with AV simulation stacks and simulation workflows.

  • Experience developing, generating, and managing simulation scenarios for autonomous driving validation.

  • Experience evaluating ODD coverage and edge-case traffic situations.



Software & Infrastructure



  • Experience integrating simulation, validation, or analytics tools into enterprise software ecosystems.

  • Experience setting up, configuring, and running Docker containers.

  • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and large-scale data processing frameworks.

  • Experience developing internal engineering tools and automation frameworks in C/C++ or Python.

  • Experience with build systems such as CMake and software development best practices.



Autonomous Driving & Safety



  • Knowledge of Autonomous Driving Safety Performance Indicators and KPIs.

  • Familiarity with ISO 21448 (SOTIF).

  • Experience supporting safety case development, safety performance evaluation, or safety requirement specification activities.



Additional Information


Please note that only selected candidates and Permanent Residents/Canadian / American Citizens will be contacted.


Job Types: Full-time, Permanent


CS Group Canada values diversity in the workplace and encourages women, visible minorities, ethnic minorities, aboriginal people, and people with disabilities to apply.

  • Hybrid Work

  • Access to a telemedicine service

  • RRSP program

  • Recreation room with pool table and foosball table

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Title: Senior Software Engineer

Location: Remote (HQ in Columbia, MD)

Position Type: Full-Time, Non-Contract position (Corporate Position)

Must be willing to submit for a security clearance. U.S. Citizenship is required.


The Opportunity

Are you creative, detail-oriented and love to create quality products? Do you enjoy working in an agile, collaborative environment? If so, we encourage you to apply! TeamWorx Security is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our growing team! As the Senior Software Engineer, you will help us expand and build our platform and products. It’s all about creation and innovation!


You will be involved in all aspects of the development process ranging from backend and front-end engineering, deploying our machine learning and AI solutions, and deploying our cloud-based systems. Working with a dynamic, innovative team, your fast-paced and thorough approach will directly influence engineering and product decisions. Your expertise and commitment to ship product will deliver business-critical functionality and the development of new features.


Our Ideal Candidate:


  • Innovative
  • Insatiably curious
  • Loves to find smart solutions to challenges
  • Likes to work in a team-oriented environment
  • Take ownership of projects and drive them to completion.
  • Possession of excellent analytical skills
  • Great attitude!


Key Responsibilities:

  • Drive next generation of software products
  • Innovate and identify opportunities
  • Participate in defining team culture and product vision
  • Develop efficient, reliable, testable code
  • Mentor team members through the product engineering lifecycle
  • Collaborate with business partners to build and launch new features
  • Exploring, learning, and building cool technologies, making mistakes, and learning along the way.


Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics or similar, and 5 years of technical experience
  • OR 8 years of technical experience (we count Military experience too!)
  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience as a Full Stack Developer or similar role
  • Must have experience with React and Node.js or similar technologies
  • Experience using and integrating AI and ML technologies into application products
  • US citizenship required and willing to submit for a DoD security clearance (if you already hold one, even better!)


What's in it for you?

No more bullet points for starters. We pay higher than industry standards! Also, these awesome perks: Comprehensive Health, Dental, & Vision Insurance, Short-Term Disability & Life Insurance, Matching 401(k) Contributions, Paid Time Off including 11 Holidays and your Birthday, Parental Leave, Professional Development, Fitness Membership, and Home Office allocations, Performance Bonuses & Profit Sharing, & Employee Referral Bonuses. But wait, there's more: TeamWorx Security is committed to our teammates and their professional goals. Being a small but growing company affords us the opportunity to work WITH YOU to reach your full potential.


A Little About Us and Our Team

We love to be inspired. We started TeamWorx Security to build, create, and dream about what inspires us, and because of this, our Maryland startup is quickly growing. We are a team of data scientists, software engineers, researchers, product developers, and operation-minded folks who specialize in developing applications and products that our customers love. Our mission is to reinvent the way technical and non-technical people work with technology. We believe in creating harmonious, automated solutions designed to improve our customers’ daily workflow, allowing them to act quickly and decisively about what matters most. We are looking for critical thinkers who excel at solving problems and have a passion for what they do to help us move our mission forward. This is our story; come tell us yours.


At TeamWorx Security, Inc., we hold our values as guiding principles in all that we do and encourage our community to embrace and embody them. Our core values are putting our people first, being curious, being authentic, being scrappy, and honoring those who serve. These values drive our company culture, decision-making, and operations.


Commitment to Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, ethnicity, age, national origin, citizenship, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, pregnancy, family structure, marital status, ancestry, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law. TeamWorx Security will also consider the employment of qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with relevant laws.

In this role, you deliver excellent customer service by living Walmart’s values, keeping the grocery area clean, organized, and well zoned, and supporting stocking and sales activities. What you'll do...

Stock Rotation and Product Quality

Pricing, Signing, and Inventory Accuracy

Food Safety and Sanitation

Health and Safety Compliance
Follows all Health and Safety guidelines and Company policies to maintain a safe, clean, and hazard-free workplace.

Energetic, Fast-Paced Environment
Thrive in a dynamic setting where every day brings something new.

Appreciation for Your Efforts
Your contributions are recognized and valued.

Career Growth Opportunities
Build your skills and advance your career with us.

Take pride in helping customers save money and live better.

title: DLP Snagging Professional (Q - CO)
description:
Jasara Program Management Company (Jasara PMC) is a leading Joint Venture between Public Investment Fund (PIF), Jacobs, and Saudi Aramco, established to deliver world-class program management services across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Jasara plays a key role in supporting the realization of Saudi Vision 2030, particularly in delivering giga-projects and large-scale infrastructure developments.

We are seeking a DLP Snagging Professional to join JASARA PMC. The DLP & Snagging Professional is responsible for supporting the identification, coordination, tracking, and close-out of defects, snags, and Defects Liability Period (DLP) obligations across assigned Qiddiya City assets. The role works closely with project teams, consultants, contractors, service providers, and operational stakeholders to ensure defects are recorded, monitored, and progressed to closure in accordance with contractual requirements, operational standards, and handover processes. The position contributes to asset handover, operational readiness, and the successful transition of assets into operational use.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support day-to-day DLP and snagging activities across assigned assets, ensuring identified defects and incomplete works are accurately logged and tracked through to resolution.
  • Participate in inspections, joint walkthroughs, snagging reviews, defect verification visits, and close-out assessments with project teams, consultants, contractors, and operational stakeholders.
  • Maintain defect and snag registers, ensuring records include ownership, priority, target dates, status updates, supporting evidence, and close-out documentation.
  • Monitor progress of defect rectification works and follow up with contractors and service providers to ensure closure within agreed timelines.
  • Assist in reviewing handover documentation, including O&M manuals, warranties, asset registers, testing and commissioning records, training documentation, and defect close-out records.
  • Update CAFM/CMMS systems, snagging platforms, dashboards, and reporting tools to ensure accurate defect tracking and status reporting.
  • Support the assessment of defects for potential impacts on safety, compliance, asset reliability, maintainability, operational performance, and customer experience.
  • Coordinate with internal teams including facilities management, infrastructure, utilities, landscaping, public realm, security, and project delivery teams to support defect resolution and interface management.
  • Contribute to readiness reviews, defect reporting, contractor performance monitoring, warranty tracking, and lessons learned activities.
  • Prepare reports, maintain records, and provide progress updates on outstanding defects, rectification activities, and DLP performance metrics

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification in Engineering, Facilities Management, Construction Management, Building Services, Asset Management, or a related discipline.
  • With 7-10 years of experience in construction completion, asset handover, DLP administration, snagging, facilities management, operations readiness, or maintenance environments.
  • Experience coordinating with contractors, consultants, and service providers on defect rectification, inspections, close-out activities, and warranty management.
  • Experience within large-scale developments, mixed-use communities, infrastructure assets, public realm environments, or similar operational environments is desirable.

  • Three or more years of Coding experience

100% Remote

title: ASIC/FPGA Design and Verification Engineer
description:
Are you a design or verification engineer with ASIC/FPGA skills, and do you have a flair for client communication? If so, then SyoSil has a great career opportunity for you.

SyoSil will soon initiate a new project, for which we search for new team members to join our existing staff of 20 highly qualified ASIC engineers. We both look for seniors as well as newly graduated engineers.

The project will focus on digital design and verification for an RF radio ASIC, being part of a large international multi-team project. In this project, SyoSil will assume the full responsibility of several IP blocks, from architecture definition towards RTL design and coverage driven verification closure. Design and verification will be done using SystemVerilog and UVM. The project management will be SCRUM based.

We offer:

  • A challenging role where you work closely with a highly skilled team as well as interfacing to engineers in leading international companies
  • Access to the latest technologies and ongoing professional development, including training with ASIC tools from the top EDA vendors in the SyoSil partnership portfolio
  • A competitive salary and a flexible working environment

SyoSil is a market leader in the ASIC R&D space, including RTL design/verification, device firmware and tool development. Our clients include top European and U.S. semiconductor companies working in specialized fields, such as the automotive, surveillance and telecommunication industries.

**Join an international team of specialists

**

You will join a young and dynamic team of 20 engineers in a vibrant international environment close to central Copenhagen, Denmark. Contributing to large-scale project execution, you will collaborate closely with experienced and highly skilled colleagues who are all specialists within their field, giving you a unique opportunity to learn and grow.

**Take part in large-scale project execution

**

As an ASIC/FPGA design and verification engineer, you will contribute to execution of projects on a large industrial scale, from concept and specification through RTL design to verification based on coverage closure. You will also deliver turn-key verification flows, verification IP and lead projects based on established and upcoming industry standards (SystemVerilog/UVM), helping clients improve their design and verification methodologies.

In relation to this, you can look forward to some international travel to liaise with clients and project execution.

**The ideal candidate

**

Experience from the industry is a plus, but not essential. What matters most is that you are skilled within ASIC/FPGA design, thoroughly systematic in your work and know how to solve parallel problems simultaneously. Furthermore, you need to have good communication and presentation skills, enabling you to establish and develop strong client relations. In addition:

  • You have a B.Sc. or an M.Sc. in electrical engineering or computer science, and you know how to debug complex systems in a traditional ASIC/FPGA design simulation environment.
  • You have solid skills within RTL module design (Verilog/VHDL), and/or experience in verification using constrained random verification methodologies, (SystemVerilog/UVM).
  • It is a strong plus if you are familiar with digital signal processing / filter design.
  • It is also an advantage if you are familiar with C++ or Python and able to debug complex software systems in a traditional Linux-based software environment.
  • You speak and write English fluently, and preferably Danish too.

If you recently graduated with very good results we strongly encourage you to apply for this position, as we are open towards investing in training you for the position.

Interested?

If you have any questions regarding the position, you are welcome to contact Peter Jensen at peter@syosil.com.

Please apply for the position by sending your application to Peter Jensen at peter@syosil.com.

Inventory Management & Replenishment

  • Set, maintain, and regularly review target stock levels to ensure inventory aligns with business needs, market demand, and supply chain constraints.
  • Maintain & review confirmation reports, ensuring MPOP / MADA settings and priority frameworks are accurate and consistently applied.
  • Monitor and control replenishment of products for all plants and imports into DCs, maximizing fill rates while minimizing backorders.
  • Manage inbound deliveries within RDC capacity limits and balance flows to optimize service.
  • Oversee direct customer orders and shipments, ensuring on-time, in-full delivery.
  • Collaborate with plants on mold/container requirements, market data setup, and other levers to optimize efficiency.
  • Utilize ERP, JDA, SCORE, WMS and other tools to manage stock, replenishment, and allocations across RDCs.
  • Identify supply chain risks (supplier, transport, geopolitical) and develop mitigation plans. Escalate supply shortages or manufacturing issues, providing alternative solutions when feasible.
  • Track and coordinate excess or obsolete inventory, implementing strategies to reduce costs due to scrapping and optimize stock levels.

Logistics & Transportation Management

  • Coordinate transportation planning across ocean, FTL, LTL, and small parcel flows, ensuring cost-efficient and reliable delivery.
  • Maximize container and truck utilization by aligning with all stakeholders about customer order sizes with FTL/container load efficiencies.
  • Monitor supplier performance to ensure adherence to quality and delivery standards. Identify and support qualification of new suppliers in collaboration with procurement, logistics and other teams.
  • Develop strategies to reduce transportation costs while maintaining service levels. coordinate transportation using TMS (Transportation Management Systems) and shipment tracking tools to optimize cost and service levels.

RDC Operations & Network Optimization

  • Support operations of Americas RDCs, ensuring stock availability and operational efficiency.
  • Develop contingency and business continuity plans for RDCs and transportation disruptions.
  • Align replenishment priorities across markets and coordinate shared RDC capacity with CST and other business units.
  • Develop long-term volume allocation and RDC sizing strategies in line with growth and network needs (next year / 5-year planning).

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Team Leadership

  • Partner with Sales, Production, Finance, Procurement and other stakeholders to align supply chain activities with business priorities.
  • Communicate priorities clearly in case of shortages or constraints.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop team members, ensuring skill growth, accountability, and high performance in a small-team environment.
  • Serve as the escalation point for operational or cross-functional issues.
  • Use ERP and reporting tools (SAP, Excel, BI dashboards) to communicate performance metrics, KPIs, and alignment outputs to stakeholders.

Strategic Planning, Special Projects & Continuous Improvement

  • Contribute to annual budget and 5-year strategic planning by modeling production, storage, and logistics capacities.
  • Lead or support special projects and regional supply chain initiatives that enhance efficiency, service, or cost competitiveness.
  • Provide input to corporate network design and long-term supply chain strategy.
  • Define and track supply chain KPIs, including fill rates, coverage, FC accuracy, costs, inventory turns, UERs, order handling, and service levels, to drive continuous improvement.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE ROLE

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain, Business Administration, or related field.
  • 5+ years of related supply chain experience
  • Advanced skills in evaluating complex numerical data, forecasting demand, and making sound, data-driven decisions.
  • Deep knowledge of demand planning, inventory management, replenishment, and end-to-end supply planning execution.
  • Skilled in SAP, Excel, and Power BI
  • Ability to generate clear insights and executive-level presentations.
  • Ability to anticipate future trends, manage competing priorities under pressure, and develop proactive strategies.
  • Experienced in partnering across functions to address operational challenges, improve efficiency, and support strategic initiatives.

Job Summary: Independently perform complex financial administration including budget development, financial analysis, and consultation. Provide recommendations for the use of financial resources.


Job-Specific Responsibilities:

As a key player in the FAS Office of Finance, the Non-Sponsored Funds Analyst will work closely with the Manager of Non-Sponsored funds to support the financial operations and planning for the Faculty of Arts and Sciences (FAS) non-sponsored funds portfolio. The Non-Sponsored Funds Analyst will help ensure that the FAS’s non-sponsored funding sources – including endowments, current use gifts, construction gifts, loan funds, and unrestricted designated funds – are properly managed, utilized, and aligned with FAS priorities.

  • Support the Manager of Non-Sponsored Funds in the routine review and analysis of non-sponsored fund balances across the FAS - currently a balance of $1.3 billion, across almost 10,000 individual Funds; independently perform day-to-day financial administration of non-sponsored funds, including verifying and monitoring spending and balances in accordance with financial policies and donor terms.
  • Consolidates data from disparate systems and sources to provide accurate reporting related to non-sponsored funds, including but not limited to budget-to-actual reporting and year-over-year trend analyses.
  • Responsible for accounting entries related to non-sponsored funds, such as interest expense/income allocation, balance forward adjustments, and pooled fund entries.
  • Reviews non-sponsored fund balances held across the FAS and works with the Manager of Non-Sponsored Funds to resolve issues, including developing plans for "hard to use”" funds.
  • Performs internal control and regulatory testing related to non-sponsored funds, including release from restriction testing, FASB 117 classifications, and high-risk expense reviews.
  • Reconciles the TBD (To Be Determined) FAS Gift and Endowments funds (defined as philanthropy received but not yet assigned terms) and work with cross-functional organizations to resolve balances.
  • Calculates support allocations to be applied to professorships and other restricted funds.
  • Collects and reviews capitalization and decapitalization requests and recommends appropriate action.
  • Gather and analyze metrics to identify streamlining opportunities in reporting across a variety of financial systems and reports.
  • Primary contact for ad hoc questions from divisions, departments, centers, and affiliate tubs.
  • Assists in identifying training needs and developing educational materials related to non-sponsored fund management.

description:
Build the bridge between devices, cloud services, and customers.

We are looking for an experienced Software Developer to join the Cloud Gateway team and help shape the future of Casambi's gateway platform.

Your primary focus will be our Cloud Gateway product, which connects physical devices to cloud services, enables secure remote management, and supports large scale deployments in customer environments. The role spans multiple technology layers, from Linux-based edge devices to cloud services, backend systems, and operational tooling.

While the gateway platform will be your main area of responsibility, you'll also have opportunities to contribute to other backend services and products as our technology landscape evolves, including several .NET-based systems and services.

We're looking for a developer who thrives in technically challenging environments, enjoys learning continuously, and actively leverages AI tools to become more productive and effective.

What you'll do

Design, develop, and maintain software for cloud-connected gateway products

Work across edge devices, operating systems, cloud services, backend systems, and operational tooling

Contribute to the architecture, security, reliability, and maintainability of gateway solutions

Develop and improve remote device management, connectivity, and software update capabilities

Investigate and solve complex issues across device, network, cloud, and application layers

Collaborate with hardware, cloud, backend, and product teams

Use AI-powered development tools to improve productivity, quality, troubleshooting, and learning

Participate throughout the full product lifecycle, from concept and development to deployment, operation, and continuous improvement

Maintain solutions after launch and develop new capabilities based on business needs and customer feedback

Contribute to multiple products and services as priorities and opportunities evolve

What we're looking for

Essential

5+ years of professional software development experience

Strong software engineering, debugging, and problem-solving skills

Ability and willingness to learn new technologies and business domains

Experience using AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity and software quality

Strong ownership mindset and ability to work independently

Interest in developing reliable, scalable, and secure systems

Strong communication and collaboration skills

Highly appreciated

Experience developing software for Linux-based systems, servers, or edge devices

Experience building secure, reliable, and maintainable distributed systems

Experience with device connectivity, remote management, or over-the-air (OTA) software update solutions

Experience with cloud platforms, backend services, or modern communication protocols such as MQTT and WebSockets

Experience with technologies such as .NET/C#, Ubuntu Core, containers, or Bluetooth

Understanding of cybersecurity and secure software development practices

Experience shipping new products or major product capabilities to customers

We support flexible and remote working. At the same time, we believe that some of the best collaboration happens face-to-face.

We expect team members to be able to visit our office approximately once per month and occasionally spend several consecutive days on-site for team events, workshops, planning sessions, or other collaborative activities.

Why join us?

You'll work on a product that spans edge devices, operating systems, cloud infrastructure, security, connectivity, remote management, and software updates throughout the entire device lifecycle.

This role offers the opportunity to solve challenging real-world problems while owning solutions that operate in production environments and support large-scale customer deployments. You'll be part of a team that values technical excellence, continuous learning, practical innovation, and the effective use of AI to build better products faster.

We value engineers who care not only about writing code, but also about delivering successful products that solve real customer problems and continue to provide value long after their initial release.

We are looking for product builders, not just feature developers. Candidates with experience bringing new products or major product capabilities from idea to customer deployment are particularly encouraged to apply.

In this role, you will support R&D and process development activities by planning and executing technical experiments, collecting and analyzing data, and providing timely feedback to engineering teams. You will be responsible for conducting test runs, preparing detailed reports and identifying processes, and equipment-related issues. This position offers the opportunity to work closely with engineers and scientists in the development and optimization of next-generation CMP technologies and processes.

In this role you will:

  • Prepare and execute CMP process experiments and wafer characterization activities.

  • Operate CMP polishing and metrology equipment safely and efficiently.

  • Analyze test data and communicate findings through technical reports and team discussions.

  • Troubleshoot process and equipment issues to improve performance and repeatability.

  • Support process development, optimization, and feasibility studies.

  • Collaborate with engineers, scientists, and cross-functional teams on technology development projects.

  • Maintain accurate documentation and ensure compliance with EHS and quality standards.

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Chemistry, or a related field

  • 2+ years’ experience working in semiconductor manufacturing, CMP process, wafer fabrication, or cleanroom environments.

  • Able to work independently in a fast-paced environment

  • Solid communication skills

  • Work in close collaboration with global engineering teams

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

  • Experience with statistical analysis software such as JMP, Minitab, or SAS is preferred.

  • Hands-on knowledge and experience in CMP processes is highly desirable.

  • Familiarity with defectivity and wafer thickness metrology is a plus.

Your success will be measured by:

  • Effectively planning and executing projects with clear goals, milestones, and deliverables.

  • Demonstrating strong ownership and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

  • Managing priorities and delivering results in a dynamic and evolving environment.

  • Showing initiative, accountability, and a strong commitment to achieving objectives.

  • Building productive relationships through effective teamwork and communication.

  • Applying critical thinking and problem-solving skills to overcome technical challenges.

  • Continuously learning from experience and driving improvements to prevent recurring issues.

title: Case Worker
description:
TITLE: Case Worker DEPARTMENT: Meskwaki Child Support Services

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

Will perform overall case management functions for MNCSS.

  • Maintains a professional environment in the MNCSS office
  • Gains excellent knowledge of the federal child support rules and laws
  • Learn and follow the MNCSS Policy & Procedure Manual, relevant Meskwaki Nation laws, and relevant federal and state regulations to carry out all case management functions
  • Reviews and processes all applications for Child Support services received by the MNCSS in accordance with MNCSS Policy and Procedure Manual
  • Responds courteously and in a timely manner to inquiries from other jurisdictions, current customers or the general public regarding MNCSS or current child support cases in accordance with the MNCSS Policy and Procedure Manual.
  • Has primary responsibility for MNCSS Tribal cases
  • Conducts in-office and telephone interviews with custodial and non-custodial parents
  • Arranges for buccal swabs for genetic testing when indicated for paternity establishment
  • Reviews child support cases and takes the next appropriate action on the cases in a timely manner in accordance with MNCSS Policy and Procedure Manual
  • Identify and utilize all collection actions on cases with the goal of minimizing family conflict by working first with the non-custodial parent to obtain cooperation when possible
  • Consults with the Case Management Supervisor to refer cases to Meskwaki Elders Circle for counseling and mediation
  • Prepares necessary paperwork for:
  • Locate activities
  • Service of Process
  • Genetic testing and Paternity actions
  • Court hearings
  • Establishment of child support orders
  • Enforcement of child support orders, including income withholding orders
  • Modification of child support orders
  • Recognition of orders from foreign jurisdictions (pursuant to full faith and credit)
  • Reviews current and past due debt obligations with the assistance of MNCSS Financial Specialist by referring to the Meskwaki Nation Child Support Guidelines and the MNCSS Policy and Procedures Manual
  • Informs the Financial Specialist about new or modified child support orders
  • Assists the Staff Attorney by preparing files for court and requests current payment history reports, when applicable, from the MNCSS Financial Specialist
  • Works closely with the Tribal Court Staff to schedule child support court cases on the upcoming court docket
  • Attends child support hearings at the Tribal Court when requested; may be required to appear as a witness for the tribal Staff Attorney or presenting officer in child support cases
  • Notifies all parties concerned regarding continuances, cancellations and rescheduling of court hearings by phone, mail or personal service
  • Ensures strict adherence to MNCSS, federal and state confidentiality agreements
  • Meticulously maintains child support files by keeping clear records of actions, conversations, and correspondence; effective maintenance of automated records may also be required
  • Cooperates with the MNCSS Financial Specialist to provide child support collection notices when requested
  • Maintains a positive working relationship with other tribal programs and local and regional employers to ensure the MNCSS payment procedures are followed
  • Works with State TANF/FIP counterparts to provide status updates whenever requested
  • Cooperates and effectively communicates with the Child Support and court staff of other jurisdictions on intergovernmental child support cases; refer cases to other Child Support programs when necessary using the approved federal transmittal forms
  • Works closely with other Tribes, States and County Child Support staff on cases that have been transferred to MNCSS
  • Provides community outreach and educational awareness to the Meskwaki community regarding MNCSS and the services it offers
  • Attends trainings that pertain to child support case management
  • Must possess excellent customer service skills with the general public, including maintaining tact, diplomacy, and flexibility when dealing with different personality of clients who call or appear in person at MNCSS, stressful situations and potential hostile people
  • Possess strong work ethic and organizational skills with special attention to detail
  • Assists MNCSS Director in the preparation of narrative and statistical reports for both tribal government offices and the Federal Office of Child Support Enforcement (OCSE) pursuant to established policy and procedures and federal regulations
  • Maintains high ethical standards for himself/herself and MNCSS by adhering to strict confidentiality standards; signs a confidentiality statement upon employment with MNCSS
  • Complies with the law of the Tribe and, at all times, acts in a manner that promotes public confidence in the integrity and impartiality of MNCSS
  • Performs other duties as needed or assigned by the immediate supervisor

REQUIREMENTS:

Must possess a BA/BS in Liberal Arts with 2 years' experience in human service or child support field

Prefer experience working the Meskwaki Indian children or families

Experience with Tribal or District Court systems

Must be or able to obtain Notary in the State of Iowa

Must be bondable

Must be able to efficiently operate office equipment, including a computer workstation, computer software, 10-key adding machine, copy and fax machines, printers and telephones

Must have a working practice of Microsoft Office applications

Must be able to record information accurately and efficiently, maintain computerized records

Must possess excellent customer service skills with the general public, including maintaining tact, diplomacy and flexibility when dealing with different personality of clients who call or appear in person at MNCSS, stressful situations and potentially hostile people.

Ability to maintain confidentiality of sensitive information

Possess strong work ethic and organizational skills with special attention to detail

Travel as required, local, regional and national for conferences, meetings, and trainings

Must possess a valid Driver's License and have a good driving record

Pre-employment drug testing is mandatory for all Meskwaki Nation positions.

Native American Preference, knowledge of Meskwaki culture and tradition

Must submit to and successfully pass a background investigation

SUPERVISION: Direct supervision by the Meskwaki Child Support Services (MNCSS) Case Manager

ANNUAL SALARY RANGE: Dependent on Qualifications and OCSS Grant Funding

Intresserad?
Urval och intervjuer kommer att ske löpande. I din ansökan vill vi ha ditt CV eller din LinkedInprofil. Personligt brev? Det kan du skippa! Vi är intresserade av din kompetens, lära känna dig gör vi vid en eventuell intervju.

I slutet av rekryteringsprocessen tillämpar vi en bakgrundskontroll på samtliga personer vi vill anställa, oavsett roll eller funktion. Då vi enbart tillämpar detta på slutkandidat informerar vi mer om det längre fram.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Strävan om att må bra är något vi delar med våra fackliga parter och tillsammans arbetar vi för en värld som mår bra. description:
Location: Bogotá or Medellín / Hybrid

About Amrize

Amrize is building North America. From bridges and railways to data centers, schools, offices, and homes, our solutions are inside the buildings and infrastructure that connect people and improve the way we live. As the partner of choice for professional builders, we offer advanced, branded solutions from foundation to rooftop. No matter where our customers are and what their jobs are, we’re ready to deliver. Our 19,000 colleagues work across 1,000 sites supported by an unparalleled distribution network. We’re involved in every construction market: infrastructure, commercial, residential, new build, repair, and refurbishment. Amrize is listed on the New York Stock Exchange and the SIX Swiss Exchange as of June 23, 2025, following our spinoff as an independent company.

Data and Analytics Engineer

Role Summary

The Data and Analytics Engineer will design, build, and maintain data and analytics solutions (pipelines, dashboards, reports, and analytical models) autonomously on corporate platforms, working closely with business units to translate their needs into actionable insights that support strategic and operational decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain dashboards, reports, stories, and analytical applications in QlikSense, SAP Analytics Cloud, and Datasphere, ensuring data availability and accuracy.
  • Build analytical and machine learning models (classification, regression, segmentation) to generate value through advanced analytics.
  • Perform exploratory analysis and apply descriptive and inferential statistical techniques to identify patterns, trends, and improvement opportunities.
  • Collaborate with business areas to gather requirements, validate data quality, and train end users on BI self-service tools.
  • Optimize SQL queries and extraction/transformation processes to improve performance and response times.
  • Implement quality controls and data governance over pipelines and data sources.
  • Document the architecture, logic, and methodology of delivered solutions to ensure traceability and maintainability.
  • Collaborate with the Finance Reporting and Analytics team and business/technical stakeholders to translate requirements into governed SAP Analytics Cloud and Datasphere solutions.

Requirements

  • Education: University degree in Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or related fields. Postgraduate studies in Analytics/Data Science (preferred).
  • Specific Experience: 4-6 years independently building data pipelines, dashboards/reports, and analytical models. Experience in financial or business processes (preferred).
  • Technical Skills: Advanced SQL, Python/R, QlikSense, SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Datasphere, data warehousing and cloud (preferably AWS). Basic-intermediate statistical modeling and machine learning. Agile methodologies and cross-functional teamwork.
  • Language: English level B2 or higher.

Benefits

  • 3 extra-legal bonuses per year, equivalent to one monthly salary each
  • Annual corporate performance bonus
  • Monthly food vouchers
  • Internet allowance
  • 12 half-days off per year
  • Birthday leave
  • 66% coverage of prepaid health plan
  • Life insurance
  • Direct indefinite term contract

Ubicación: Bogotá o Medellín / Híbrido

Acerca de Amrize

Amrize está construyendo Norteamérica. Desde puentes y vías férreas hasta centros de datos, escuelas, oficinas y hogares, nuestras soluciones están dentro de los edificios y la infraestructura que conectan a las personas y mejoran nuestra forma de vivir. Como socio preferido para constructores profesionales, ofrecemos soluciones de marca avanzadas desde los cimientos hasta el techo. Dondequiera que estén nuestros clientes y sea cual sea su trabajo, estamos listos para cumplir. Nuestros 19 000 colegas operan en 1000 sedes y cuentan con el apoyo de una red de distribución inigualable. Estamos presentes en todos los mercados de la construcción: infraestructuras, comercial, residencial, nuevas construcciones, reparaciones y reformas. Amrize cotiza en la Bolsa de Valores de Nueva York y en el SIX Swiss Exchange desde el 23 de junio de 2025, tras nuestra escisión como empresa independiente.

Ingeniero de Analítica de Datos

Resumen del Rol

El Ingeniero de Analítica de Datos diseñará, construirá y mantendrá de forma autónoma soluciones de datos y analítica (pipelines, dashboards, reportes y modelos analíticos) sobre las plataformas corporativas, colaborando estrechamente con las unidades de negocio para traducir sus necesidades en información e insights accionables que respalden la toma de decisiones estratégicas y operativas.

Responsabilidades Clave

  • Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener dashboards, reportes, historias y aplicaciones analíticas en QlikSense, SAP Analytics Cloud y Datasphere, garantizando disponibilidad y precisión de los datos.
  • Desarrollar modelos analíticos y de inteligencia artificial/aprendizaje automático (clasificación, regresión, segmentación) para generar predicciones e insights de valor para el negocio.
  • Realizar análisis exploratorio y aplicar técnicas estadísticas descriptivas e inferenciales para identificar patrones, tendencias y oportunidades de mejora.
  • Colaborar con las áreas de negocio para levantar requerimientos, validar la calidad de los datos y capacitar a usuarios finales en herramientas de BI self-service.
  • Optimizar consultas SQL y procesos de extracción/transformación para mejorar el rendimiento de las soluciones de datos.
  • Implementar controles de calidad y gobierno de datos sobre los pipelines y fuentes bajo su responsabilidad.
  • Documentar la arquitectura, lógica y metodología de las soluciones desarrolladas para asegurar su trazabilidad y mantenibilidad.
  • Colaborar con el equipo de Finance Reporting and Analytics y stakeholders técnicos y de negocio para traducir requerimientos en soluciones gobernadas de SAP Analytics Cloud y Datasphere.

Requisitos

  • Educación: Profesional en Ingeniería, Estadística, Matemáticas, Economía o carreras afines. Posgrado en Analítica/Ciencia de Datos (deseable).
  • Experiencia: 4 a 6 años construyendo de forma independiente pipelines de datos, dashboards e informes, y modelos analíticos. Experiencia en procesos financieros o de negocio (deseable).
  • Habilidades Técnicas: SQL avanzado, Python/R, QlikSense, SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Datasphere, almacenamiento de datos (warehousing) y nube (preferiblemente AWS). Modelado estadístico y machine learning básico-intermedio. Metodologías ágiles y trabajo en equipos multidisciplinarios.
  • Idioma: Inglés nivel B2 o superior.

Beneficios

  • Bono anual de resultados corporativos
  • Bono canasta mensual
  • Auxilio de conectividad

For over forty years, HarbourVest has been home to a committed team of professionals with an entrepreneurial spirit and a desire to deliver impactful solutions to our clients and investing partners. For example, you may choose to work in the office 4 days per week and take one remote day weekly (typically 13 weeks per quarter), leaving 5 additional remote days to be used as needed.

About Evergreen Portfolio Management

The Evergreen Portfolio Management team manages HarbourVest’s product suite of private equity evergreen portfolios. The team actively manages fund liquidity, supports new investment activity, partners with the HarbourVest salesforce to market these products to investors, and advises on the launch of new product portfolios. We are looking to expand our team amid strong momentum and growing demand for our evergreen offerings. Within the current team of six professionals, we value individuals who bring an entrepreneurial mindset are eager to have a meaningful impact at HarbourVest.

As an Evergreen Portfolio Management Associate, you will support the portfolio and fund management activities of private equity evergreen funds offered to high net worth and institutional investors. This role will work closely with our investment strategy teams as well as a wide array of teams that manage or support our evergreen fund products.

The ideal candidate is someone who is:

  • A self-starter who is attentive to detail and focused on the execution of responsibilities

  • A team-player that is organized and can efficiently prioritize multiple projects to meet target dates with little direct supervision

What you will do:

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and data visualization tools such as PowerBI and MicroStrategy

Education Preferred

Experience

title: Lead Site Reliability Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Lead Site Reliability Engineer to become part of our team. In this position, you'll partner closely with backend developers, product managers, and fellow SREs to spot potential risks before they escalate into full-blown incidents — and when problems do surface, you'll take charge of driving the response and subsequent analysis.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and sustain monitoring, alerting, and observability systems, covering metrics, logs, and traces, to support debit card services
  • Develop and manage dashboards that display availability, latency, error rates, and other critical reliability indicators for both engineering teams and leadership
  • Establish and monitor Service Level Objectives (SLOs), Service Level Indicators (SLIs), and error budgets tied to essential debit card processes, such as authorization, settlement, card issuance, and dispute handling
  • Continuously oversee system health and stability, catching signs of degradation early to prevent negative effects on customers
  • Take part in on-call schedules, driving or contributing to incident resolution, root cause investigation, and blameless retrospectives
  • Team up with product and engineering groups to assess architecture from the standpoint of reliability, scalability, and resilience to failure
  • Streamline repetitive operational tasks through automation and custom tooling to cut down on manual toil
  • Perform capacity forecasting and load testing to confirm systems can handle growing transaction demands
  • Enhance the safety of releases by leveraging canary deployments, automated rollbacks, and progressive rollout techniques
  • Help develop and uphold reliability standards, runbooks, and operational documentation throughout the team

Requirements

  • At least 5 years of relevant experience working as a Site Reliability Engineer, DevOps Engineer, or Production/Infrastructure Engineer
  • A minimum of one year of experience guiding and overseeing teams
  • Practical experience using observability and monitoring platforms such as Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog, or comparable internal metrics systems
  • Solid grasp of SLOs, SLIs, error budgets, and broader reliability engineering concepts
  • Command of at least one programming language typically used for automation and tooling, such as Go, Python, or Java
  • Background working with distributed systems and awareness of common failure patterns in high-volume, low-latency settings
  • Working familiarity with container orchestration tools and infrastructure, including Kubernetes and Docker, plus experience with cloud or on-premises environments at scale
  • Exposure to incident management workflows, covering on-call duties, root cause diagnosis, and postmortem reviews
  • Solid scripting and automation capabilities aimed at minimizing operational toil, using languages such as Bash or Python
  • Practical understanding of CI/CD pipelines and secure deployment techniques, including canary releases, blue-green deployments, and rollback approaches
  • Strong communication abilities, capable of turning system performance data into understandable insights for technical and non-technical audiences alike
  • Excellent English communication skills (B2 level or higher)

Nice to have

  • Background working within payments, fintech, or other tightly regulated, transaction-sensitive industries
  • Understanding of PCI-DSS or similar financial industry compliance and security standards
  • Exposure to chaos engineering or fault-injection methodologies for resilience testing
  • Experience with database reliability topics, such as query optimization, replication, and failover, within transactional systems
  • Background developing or supporting internal tools and platforms designed for large-scale observability

Benefits

  • International projects with top brands
  • Work with global teams of highly skilled, diverse peers
  • Healthcare benefits
  • Employee financial programs
  • Paid time off and sick leave
  • Upskilling, reskilling and certification courses
  • Unlimited access to the LinkedIn Learning library and 22,000+ courses
  • Global career opportunities
  • Volunteer and community involvement opportunities
  • EPAM Employee Groups
  • Award-winning culture recognized by Glassdoor, Newsweek and LinkedIn

title: Marine Technician I - Marine
description:
Job Description

Fugro's Marine business delivers the data, insights, and operational support required to safely and efficiently develop, build, and maintain offshore and coastal infrastructure. Through surveying, site characterization, positioning, inspection, monitoring, and consulting services, the team helps clients reduce risk and make informed decisions across the lifecycle of marine projects

The Marine Technician I is an entry-level technical position responsible for supporting offshore, nearshore, and onshore marine operations across multiple service lines, including Hydrographic, Geophysical, Geotechnical, ROV, AUV, MetOcean, and Marine Survey operations. The role assists with the installation, operation, maintenance, troubleshooting, calibration, and repair of a wide range of marine equipment, instrumentation, sensors, data acquisition systems, and support technologies.

Working under the guidance of experienced technical personnel, the Marine Technician I develops technical proficiency through structured training, field experience, mentorship, and competency-based career progression. This position requires a strong technical aptitude, commitment to safety, and the ability to work in challenging marine and offshore environments.

Job Responsibilities

  • Lead by example and place Quality, Health & Safety, Security, and the protection of the Environment as core values while never intentionally placing employees, our processes, customers, or the communities in which we live and work at risk.
  • Assist with the installation, mobilization, integration, testing, operation, maintenance, and repair of marine equipment and systems.
  • Support offshore and onshore operations across Hydrographic, Geophysical, Geotechnical, ROV, AUV, MetOcean, and Marine Survey projects.
  • Perform equipment inspections, preventative maintenance, calibrations, and functional testing.
  • Troubleshoot basic to intermediate electrical, electronic, mechanical, networking, software, and data acquisition issues.
  • Support equipment mobilization and demobilization activities on vessels and project sites.
  • Maintain equipment inventories, maintenance records, technical documentation, and project reports.
  • Ensure compliance with all Company HSE policies, procedures, and quality standards.
  • Work collaboratively with project managers, engineers, surveyors, scientists, vessel crews, and field personnel.
  • Participate in technical training programs and competency development initiatives.
  • Maintain operational readiness of assigned equipment and work areas.
  • Travel and work offshore, nearshore, and at remote project locations as required.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Job Requirements

  • Legally authorized to work in the United States, without restrictions.
  • Possess the ability to obtain a valid passport for international travel.
  • GED or High school diploma required, with minimum of a year or more experience.
  • Must be able to pass an OGUK physical and a DOT drug screen.
  • Must possess a current BOSIET certification or be able to complete it within 3 weeks of employment.
  • Associate of Science (A.S.) degree in Marine Technology, Electronics, Engineering Technology, Instrumentation, Computer Technology, Computer Networking, or a related technical discipline.
  • Relevant military technical training and experience
  • No prior professional marine industry experience required for candidates with relevant technical education or military training.
  • Frequent travel and offshore assignments may be required.
  • Previous experience with electronics, instrumentation, mechanics, networking, data acquisition systems, marine operations, ROVs, AUVs, or related technical fields is beneficial but not required.
  • Basic understanding of electrical, electronic, mechanical, and computer-based systems.
  • Demonstrated mechanical aptitude and troubleshooting ability.
  • Ability to learn marine equipment, instrumentation, software, and data acquisition systems.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain required offshore medical and safety certifications.
  • Strong problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills.
  • Ability to read and follow technical procedures, manuals, and equipment documentation.
  • Ability to work effectively in team-oriented, offshore, and field environments.
  • Commitment to safety, quality, and continuous learning.
  • Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally as required.

Development and Competency

  • This position is designed as a structured technical development role intended to build competency across multiple marine service lines.
  • Employees are expected to reside in the Lafayette, Louisiana area for a minimum of two (2) years to support training, mentorship, and competency development requirements.
  • Successful completion of required training programs, safety certifications, and technical development milestones is required.
  • Employees must participate in and successfully pass annual competency reviews demonstrating progression in technical knowledge, operational proficiency, and equipment competency.
  • Continued advancement within the Marine Technician career path is contingent upon achieving and maintaining established competency standards.
  • Work may be performed aboard vessels, docks, fabrication facilities, warehouses, and remote project locations.
  • Ability to work extended hours and rotational schedules as project requirements dictate.

What’s in it for you?

At Fugro, our people are our number one priority and central to our purpose to create a safe and livable world. Our values set the foundation for our unique culture: we are determined to deliver, we prepare for tomorrow, we do what’s right, and we build trust. Our talent philosophy is seeded by our values and fueled by a passion for learning, developing leadership behaviors, transparency, and accountability.

Fugro offers opportunities to sharpen skills and provide career growth through on-the-job learning experiences, LinkedIn Learning access, business and technical training, and leadership development programs.

We value the mental, physical, and financial health of our employees and their families and offer a variety of flexible work models. Fugro USA’s comprehensive benefits package also ensures you have choices that fit your needs at any life stage.

How to apply?

If you are interested in this role we look forward to discussing this opportunity with you. Please click on our ‘apply’ button and upload your resume and cover letter.

title: Data Engineer (SnowFlake)
description:
Run Stronger. Evolve Faster. Perform Smarter with NRI

Ready to shape what's next?

At NRI, we turn technology into intelligence, delivering solutions that drive measurable business outcomes. Join our team of 3,500+ local experts backed by a global network of 16,000 team members and work on projects that truly make a difference for Australia's leading organisations.

Our Managed Services team ensures businesses operate at peak efficiency, resilience, and scale. Join us to manage and optimise IT landscapes for leading organisations, delivering seamless, reliable, and measurable outcomes every day.

The Data Engineer role offers the opportunity to play a critical part in the stability, performance, and continuous improvement of customer data platforms built on Snowflake, while working in a support environment where operational excellence matters. It provides the chance to combine deep technical problem-solving with practical engineering, supporting business-critical pipelines, improving service reliability, and helping shape better support processes, monitoring, and governance. For someone who enjoys both hands‑on data engineering and service ownership, it is an opportunity to become the trusted expert who keeps data flowing, reduces operational risk, and contributes directly to better outcomes for clients and internal teams.

What You'll Do:

Service Operations

  • Provide Level 2 and Level 3 support for Snowflake-based data platforms, data pipelines, and integrations in accordance with agreed service levels, support models, and operational procedures.
  • Monitor platform availability, warehouse utilisation, job execution, pipeline performance, and data quality controls to identify and address issues proactively before service impact occurs.
  • Investigate and resolve incidents, service requests, and data-related issues across ingestion, transformation, storage, semantic and downstream consumption layers.
  • Perform detailed root cause analysis for recurring, complex, or high-impact incidents, and implement permanent fixes to improve service stability and reduce repeat failures.
  • Participate in on-call, escalation, and major incident support processes where required, ensuring timely communication, impact assessment, and restoration of service.

Platform Support and Enhancement

  • Develop, maintain, and support SQL-based transformations, stored logic, pipeline fixes, and minor enhancements required to meet operational and business needs.
  • Support scheduled releases, changes, deployments, and post-implementation validation activities in line with change management and release governance processes.
  • Assist with the support and optimisation of Snowflake objects and services, including databases, schemas, warehouses, tasks, streams, procedures, and integrations with upstream and downstream platforms.
  • Identify opportunities to improve performance, reliability, scalability and cost effectiveness across Snowflake workloads, query execution and supporting data processes.
  • Contribute to automation of support activities, including monitoring, alerting, remediation tasks, housekeeping, and repeatable operational procedures.

Security and Governance

  • Apply security, access control, governance, and audit requirements in the day-to-day support and operation of Snowflake environments.
  • Support the administration of role‑based access controls, least‑privilege access, and controlled segregation of duties across client environments.
  • Assist in implementing and maintaining data protection controls such as masking, row‑level access policies, and secure handling of sensitive datasets where required.
  • Ensure operational activities comply with client, contractual, and organisational standards for auditability, traceability, and change control.
  • Contribute to security incident response, investigation and recovery activities by using audit history, usage data, and operational logs to identify issues and support remediation.

Stakeholder and Service Management

  • Work closely with client stakeholders, internal service teams, and delivery teams to prioritise incidents, defects, enhancements, risks and service improvement opportunities.
  • Provide clear and timely communication on incident status, problem investigations, service risks, and planned changes to relevant stakeholders.

Documentation and Knowledge Management

  • Maintain accurate operational documentation, including support procedures, runbooks, known error records, knowledge articles and technical support notes.
  • Document fixes, workarounds, recurring issue patterns and platform dependencies to improve support efficiency and knowledge reuse across the support team.
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of support standards, monitoring baselines, and operating procedures for Snowflake-managed services.

What We're Looking For:

  • Strong hands‑on experience supporting Snowflake data platforms, including troubleshooting pipelines, transformations, integrations and downstream data issues.
  • Advanced SQL capability, with the ability to develop, refine and support data transformations and operational fixes efficiently.
  • Solid understanding of data engineering concepts, including ingestion, orchestration, data quality, performance tuning and platform dependencies.
  • Proven incident and problem management skills, with the ability to investigate root causes, implement permanent fixes and prevent repeat failures.
  • Working knowledge of Snowflake security and governance, including access control, least‑privilege principles, auditability and controlled data access.
  • Experience supporting releases and changes in a managed services or operational support environment, with disciplined use of change processes.
  • Strong monitoring and analytical skills, with the ability to detect service degradation, trend recurring issues and act proactively.
  • Clear stakeholder communication skills, with the ability to prioritise work, manage expectations and explain technical issues in plain language.
  • Well‑developed documentation and knowledge management habits, including runbooks, support notes, known errors and operational procedures.
  • A continuous improvement mindset, with the ability to identify automation opportunities, improve supportability and enhance service reliability over time.

Why Join Us:

  • Deliver tangible business impact through operational excellence.
  • Work with cutting‑edge tools and AI‑enabled platforms.
  • Be part of a high‑performing, client‑obsessed team that values growth and innovation.

Your skills. Our impact. Together unstoppable. At NRI, you'll work on meaningful projects, tackle complex challenges and see the tangible difference your expertise makes. We value diverse experiences and perspectives, creating an inclusive, collaborative and high‑performing workplace. Don't worry if you don't meet every requirement listed - we prioritise attitude and capability and you might be the perfect fit for this role or another within NRI.

NRI Australia & New Zealand is committed to building a culturally diverse and inclusive workplace and strongly encourages applications regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, sexual orientation or disability.

title: Cyber Security Lead Engineer
description:
Objective: (summary about the position)

Seeking a highly experienced Security Lead Engineer to lead the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of cybersecurity measures across our hybrid environment. This role requires overseeing infrastructure, application, and cloud security; managing threat detection and response systems; guiding the security posture of internally developed software; and ensuring regulatory compliance through GRC frameworks. The ideal candidate brings technical depth, leadership capabilities, and a proactive mindset to protect our digital assets and business operations.

Responsibilities:

1. Security Architecture & Strategy

  • Design, integrate, and maintain end-to-end security architecture for on-premises and cloud environments.
  • Ensure secure network topology including segmentation, access control, and VPN tunnels.
  • Lead development and enforcement of security policies, procedures, and best practices.
  • Work closely with developers and IT architects to embed security into application and infrastructure design.

2. SOC, SIEM, and Threat Management

  • Oversee the operation and tuning of Security Operations Center (SOC) including SIEM platforms.
  • Manage endpoint protection through EDR and threat-hunting solutions.
  • Manage and enhance email security systems to protect against phishing, malware, and spam, ensuring compliance with organizational security policies.
  • Lead incident response efforts and develop threat prevention strategies.

3. Application and Cloud Security

  • Supervise vulnerability scanning and penetration testing for internally developed applications.
  • Lead WAF deployment and optimization to protect business-critical web applications.
  • Implement security best practices and policy enforcement across multi-cloud environments

4. Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC)

  • Drive cybersecurity-related compliance programs (e.g., SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001).
  • Lead cross-functional GRC initiatives and support internal/external audits.
  • Manage security risk assessments and recommend mitigation strategies.

5. Documentation & Collaboration

  • Maintain detailed documentation for security controls, policies, systems, and incidents.
  • Plan and conduct quarterly security awareness sessions to educate staff on emerging cyber threats, security best practices, and the organization's security policies.
  • Work collaboratively with software engineers, network teams, DevOps, and business units.

Requirements

Min requirements:

1. Education: Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Security or a related field.

2. Experience:

· 7 years in cybersecurity and information security roles.

· 5+ years of hands-on experience in security architecture and threat management.

3. Qualifications necessary for the vacancy.

· Proven expertise in:

o Security architecture for hybrid cloud/on-prem setups.

o Firewalls, WAF, EDR, SIEM, UTM, IPS, Proxy, and DDoS mitigation.

o Network security protocols, subnetting, VPNs, and access control models.

4. Set of skills necessary for the vacancy.

· Problem-Solving and Analytical Skills:

o Ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues efficiently.

o Skilled in designing and implementing scalable and secure IT solutions.

· Organizational Skills:

o Strong ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks effectively.

o Commitment to meeting deadlines and maintaining high-quality standards.

· Communication and Teamwork:

o Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

o Ability to collaborate effectively with team members and stakeholders.

5. Certifications (Desirable):

· CISSP, CISM, CEH, OSCP, CCSP

· Cloud security certifications (e.g., AWS Security Specialty, Microsoft SC-100/SC-200)

· IT governance certifications (e.g., ISO 27001 LA, CISA)

title: Security Operations Administrator
location: New York, New York, United States
description:
The Atria Health Institute is a membership-based primary and specialty health care practice with a focus on prevention and longevity. We bring together a multidisciplinary team of renowned physicians to provide proactive, preventive, and precision-based care for Atria members and their families. All care, including primary care, advanced screening and diagnostics, urgent care, specialty care, 24/7 home visits, and imaging is included in members’ annual fee.

Our mission is to make healthspan and lifespan equal for all by translating science into medicine in real-time, all while bringing humanity back into health care. Delivering such robust, personalized, and preventive health care is complex and requires a team-wide dedication to excellence.

We have state-of-the-art facilities with imaging and diagnostics on-site in New York City, Palm Beach, and Los Angeles, with home services hubs in Miami, Greenwich/Westchester, and the Hamptons in summer. Additional locations are forthcoming in the Bay Area, Miami, and in downtown Manhattan. At each of our Institutes, we deliver personalized preventive medicine grounded in up-to-the-minute science — all in serene environments designed for trust and comfort.

About this role

The Security Operations Administrator is a founding member of our security team responsible for supporting the deployment, day-to-day administration, maintenance, monitoring, and operational effectiveness of Atria’s cybersecurity platforms. This role will help strengthen Atria’s cybersecurity maturity by ensuring core security tools are properly maintained, documented, tuned, and operationally aligned with IT, Engineering, and business needs.

This position will work closely with the IT Team, Engineering Team, vendors, and implementation partners to support Atria’s growing cybersecurity program. The role is intended for a hands-on security operations professional who can manage practical administrative tasks while having significant opportunity to mature our overall security program over time.

Reporting Structure

Reports to: VP of Information Technology

Works closely with: Software Foundations team (leadership, Platform and DevOps Team Leads), IT Help Desk, vendors, and implementation partners

Responsibilities

The Security Operations Administrator will be responsible for supporting the ongoing operation of Atria’s cybersecurity tools and related processes, including:

  • Administer and maintain assigned cybersecurity platforms, including, Zscaler, Armis,, SentinelOne and related systems.
  • Support daily security operations activities, including alert review and tuning, triage, escalation, and follow-up tracking.
  • Support our MSSP with alert configuration, runbooks, tuning.
  • Assist with the ongoing administration of identity, endpoint, asset management, privileged access, and email security controls.
  • Support asset discovery, inventory validation, asset tagging, ownership mapping, and reconciliation across multiple platforms.
  • Maintain accurate documentation for platform ownership, administrative access, configuration standards, operational procedures, and support workflows.
  • Coordinate with vendors and certified partners after implementation to ensure proper handoff, knowledge transfer, and operational readiness.
  • Assist with user-reported phishing workflows, email security investigations, and awareness-related follow-up.
  • Support privileged access management processes, access reviews, credential lifecycle tasks, and exception tracking.
  • Coordinate with the DevOps team on cloud security, Zscaler, Rubrik, GCP, Cloudflare, GitHub Advanced Security, and related security requirements.
  • Prepare recurring operational reports for IT leadership, and executive stakeholders.
  • Track remediation items, open issues, platform risks, and operational gaps through completion.
  • Collaborate with IT and Engineering on patching, configuration management, endpoint compliance, and device security workflows as needed.
  • Participate in security incidents, investigations, tabletop exercises, and maturity improvement initiatives as needed.

Key Platforms and Technology Areas

This role may support or coordinate across the following technology areas:

  • Email security
  • Asset discovery and inventory
  • Endpoint detection and response
  • Endpoint management
  • Mobile device management
  • Identity and access management
  • Privileged access management
  • Network security
  • Cloud security
  • Backup and recovery
  • Vulnerability and patch management
  • Security reporting and documentation

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in IT operations, security operations, systems administration, endpoint administration, or a related technical role.
  • Practical experience administering security or infrastructure platforms in a small to mid-sized environment.
  • Working knowledge of identity, endpoint, asset management, patching, and security operations concepts.
  • Experience with one or more of the following tools; Okta, Intune, Kandji, SentinelOne, NinjaOne, Fortinet, Armis, Abnormal Security, Zscaler, Rubrik, GCP, Cloudflare, or GitHub security tooling.
  • Ability to perform basic security alert review, troubleshooting, and escalation.
  • Strong documentation skills, including the ability to create runbooks, procedures, checklists, and operational tracking documents.
  • Ability to work across IT, DevOps, security, and vendor teams.
  • Strong attention to detail and follow-through.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a small-team environment.
  • Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in healthcare, life sciences, research, or other regulated environments.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA, privacy, data protection, or clinical operations.
  • Experience supporting cloud environments, especially Google Cloud Platform.
  • Experience with privileged access management or identity governance.
  • Experience with asset discovery, CMDB cleanup, device ownership mapping, or inventory normalization.
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks such as CIS Controls or NIST CSF.
  • Familiarity with emerging artificial intelligence (AI) capabilities and their application across relevant cybersecurity domains including but not limited to; network security, Identity, endpoint management and data security.
  • Certifications such as Security+, CySA+, SSCP, Okta, Google Cloud, or other relevant vendor certifications.

Success Measures

Success in this role will be measured by:

  • Improved ownership and administration of cybersecurity platforms.
  • More accurate asset inventory and device ownership records.
  • Reduced operational burden on the IT and DevOps teams.
  • Improved documentation and repeatability of security processes.
  • Timely follow-up on security alerts, platform issues, and remediation tasks.
  • Strong coordination between IT, DevOps, and external vendors.
  • Clear reporting on security platform health, open risks, and operational progress.
  • Effective use of interns for low-risk, repeatable support tasks.

Role Scope

This is a hands-on operational role. The Security Operations Administrator is not expected to independently design Atria’s full cybersecurity strategy or own all security risk decisions. Instead, this role is responsible for helping ensure that Atria’s cybersecurity platforms are properly administered, monitored, documented, and used effectively.

Salary range: $100,000-$160,000

  • OneMedical membership for employees & dependents, giving access to 24/7 virtual care
