title: Graduate Quantitative Researcher (2027 Start)
description:
If you enjoy using mathematics and code to investigate difficult questions, you could make a direct contribution to Optiver’s success in global markets. As a Graduate Quantitative Researcher, you’ll work across the full research process, from framing the question and choosing the data to building, testing and deploying models. Machine Learning is central to the work, whether you’re extracting signals, forecasting prices or modelling relationships. Our data, compute and production infrastructure let you test ideas quickly, understand where they fail and decide what to investigate next.

Our researchers believe in academic discourse and invite fellow researchers, traders and engineers to challenge each hypothesis. Different perspectives help improve the question, the model and how it performs in production. Through constant testing, analysis and refinement, you’ll help our quantitative models adapt as markets evolve.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Your onboarding

You’ll participate in Global Optiver Academy, a structured onboarding programme for graduates. It gives new joiners a shared foundation in how Optiver trades, builds systems, and manages risk before they move into their teams. As part of your onboarding, you'll gain exposure to the AI tools and technologies that support research and development across the business.

Your responsibilities

Depending on the team you join, you'll own the research end to end. That could include:

  • Building models for pricing, forecasting and signal discovery, choosing the statistical, mathematical or Machine Learning methods that best fit the problem.
  • Working across petabytes of market, order-flow and unstructured data to find signals that improve strategies as conditions change.
  • Monitoring models in production and using live behavior to refine your assumptions and decide what to investigate next.
  • Using deep learning and AI-enabled workflows to shorten the loop from hypothesis to evidence.
  • Working directly with researchers, traders and engineers to shape problems and understand how system constraints affect performance.

WHO YOU ARE

We're looking for aspiring Quantitative Researchers who are versatile and creative in innovating and suggesting new solutions. In return, we'll give you the freedom to pursue your ideas and implement them right into our production systems.

In terms of skills and qualifications, we're looking for:

  • An academic degree in Engineering, Physics, Maths, Econometrics, Computer science or equivalent, with outstanding academic achievements
  • Programming experience in any language (preferably Python, but C, C++, Basic, JAVA, etc. are also a plus)
  • Ability to apply concepts of probability, calculus and linear algebra
  • Competitive attitude and eagerness to constantly improve
  • Ability to learn quickly
  • Excellent verbal and written English language skills

WHAT YOU’LL GET

You’ll join a culture of collaboration and excellence, where you’ll be surrounded by curious thinkers and creative problem solvers. Motivated by a passion for continuous improvement, you’ll thrive in a supportive, high-performing environment alongside talent colleagues, working collaboratively to tackle the toughest problems in the financial markets.

In addition, you’ll receive:

  • A performance-based bonus structure, enabling all of our employees to benefit from our global profit pool
  • The opportunity to work alongside best-in-class professionals from over 50 countries
  • 25 paid vacation days in your first year, increasing to 30 from your second year onwards
  • Training opportunities, discounts on health benefits, and fully paid first-class commuting expenses
  • Extensive office perks, including breakfast, lunch and dinner, world-class barista coffee, bi-weekly chair massages, Friday afternoon drinks, a bicycle to explore Amsterdam and much more
  • Training and continuous learning opportunities, including access to conferences and tech events
  • Competitive relocation packages and visa sponsorship where necessary for expats

HOW TO APPLY

Are you interested in furthering your career on one of the most dynamic and exciting trading floors in Europe?

Apply directly via the form below for the position of Graduate Quantitative Researcher. Please provide us with a CV in English. Unfortunately we cannot accept applications via email for data protection reasons.

If your application is selected to proceed to the next round, you will be required to complete online assessments. By submitting your application you are confirming that you will be able to take the assessment within 7 days.

Kindly note that we do not require any assistance from third-parties including agencies in the recruitment of this role. If you have any questions feel free to contact our Recruitment team via our recruitment inquiry form.

Diversity statement

Optiver is committed to diversity and inclusion.

We encourage applications from candidates from any and all backgrounds, and we welcome requests for reasonable adjustments during the process to ensure that you can best demonstrate your abilities. Please let us know if you would like to request any reasonable adjustments by contacting the Recruitment team via the contact form, selecting "Reasonable Adjustments" as the subject of your inquiry

For answers to some of our most frequently asked questions, refer to our recruitment FAQ.

For applicants based in India, our entry route is via the placement office internship hiring season (July/August).

*Optiver has a global application re-apply policy for our intern and graduate roles. If you have completed an online assessment or interviewed for a quantitative graduate or internship role at any Optiver location in the past 8 months, please note that you are not yet eligible to reapply. We welcome you to re-apply after the 8-month cool off period.

Job Title: Data& Integration Engineer

This role is responsible for ensuring reliable delivery of application data flows and integrations across multiple environments, working closely with engineering, infrastructure, QA, and domain teams.

The ideal candidate has strong troubleshooting skills, a solid understanding of data integration architectures, and hands‑on experience with cloud platforms, CI/CD pipelines, and databases.

Key Responsibilities

Delivery, Integration & Deployment Support

  • Take ownership of data and integration delivery for new product applications and customer onboardings.
  • Support application deployments and integrations across multiple layers, including databases, services, configurations, and external systems.

Complex Troubleshooting & Root Cause Analysis

Cross‑Team Collaboration

Data Integration & Architecture Understanding

Environment & Configuration Management

Monitoring, Logging & Issue Resolution

Documentation & Communication

Technical Skills

Environment & Delivery Experience

  • Experience working across Dev, QA, UAT, and Production environments.
  • Understanding of configuration management and environment‑specific behaviours.
  • Experience supporting production or customer‑facing systems.

Soft Skills

  • Strong problem‑solving and analytical skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
  • Ability to document technical processes clearly and accurately.
  • Comfortable working in cross‑functional and distributed teams.

Nice to Have

  • Experience onboarding new customers or supporting new product launches.
  • Familiarity with automated deployment and release processes.
  • Experience working in large‑scale or enterprise environments.

title: Senior Product Manager, Charging Experience
description:
Our Purpose

ChargeLab is a fast-growing software company on a mission to build the ultimate EV charging infrastructure. The next decade is all about electric vehicles, and we’re at the forefront by developing the systems that power charging networks worldwide. By 2030, most vehicles sold in North America will be EVs—and we’re building the software to support them.
ChargeLab is backed by top investors and partners, and we’re rapidly scaling to meet the growing demand for EV infrastructure. If you’re up for tackling complex challenges, making a real impact, and seeing your work support thousands of EV charging stations, then come be a part of our journey!

How You’ll Make an Impact

As a Senior Product Manager at ChargeLab, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of our EV driver interfaces. You will define the strategy and roadmap for our EV driver apps (web and mobile), ensuring that they deliver a simple, reliable and consistent experience, whether the user is charging their vehicle at home or within our network of public chargers. Your work will directly impact the daily lives of thousands of EV drivers, leading to improvements in public perception, customer satisfaction, business scalability and the success of our ChargeLab Rewards rebate program. Your work will make the ChargeLab network of chargers available more broadly in other apps, and bring other apps’ drivers into our network, as well. You’ll partner closely with other product managers to bring business and reliability priorities to life in the driver experience.
You will collaborate closely with engineers, designers, and business stakeholders across Marketing, Support, and Operations to build and refine solutions. This is a high-impact role where you will drive data-driven decision-making and play a key part in ChargeLab’s growth.

About Product at ChargeLab

At ChargeLab, we empower our product teams to solve both customer and business problems in ways that our users love and that drive our company forward.
Our product teams are cross-functional and fluid, typically comprised of a Product Manager, a Product Designer, and a team of engineers. Product managers here don’t just execute features—they own outcomes. We expect PMs to define success metrics, analyze data, collaborate with stakeholders, and influence their peers to drive real impact.
If you thrive on autonomy, enjoy solving complex challenges, and love seeing your work shape an industry, this role is for you.

What you'll do

• Own the strategy and roadmap for driver-facing applications, including native mobile apps, web app, and customer white labeled apps. You’ll also contribute to the site host experience when your features impact both drivers & site hosts.
• Serve as the resident expert on the charging experience, consumer needs, and the competitive landscape for drivers.
• Champion the EV driver’s perspective, and emphasize the value of a growing group of drivers to commercial customer success
• Work with Product Operations and Engineering to ensure we treat data as a first class citizen, empowering analytics and reporting
• Define and track key product metrics to measure success and drive data-informed decisions.
• Work closely with internal and external stakeholders to build solutions that make home and public charging and seamless for users.
• Collaborate with engineering, design, and business teams to deliver impactful product improvements.
• Drive go-to-market strategies in partnership with Sales, Marketing, and Operations teams.
• Continuously refine the product vision and strategy, ensuring alignment with company goals.
• Deliver iterative, incremental improvements while working towards long-term strategic goals.

Your experience

• 5+ years of professional product management experience in a SaaS or consumer software company.
• A proven track record of launching and managing successful B2C mobile products.
• Strong analytical skills with experience in data-driven decision-making.
• Prior experience with native mobile development, payments, web analytics is a strong plus.
• Excellent stakeholder management and ability to work cross-functionally with finance, sales, marketing, and engineering teams.
• Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
• A passion for EV charging and making a positive impact on the environment.
• Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent experience .

title: UniData/ UniVerse Data Engineer (Remote)

description:
Position Overview
We are seeking an experienced UniData / Universe Data Engineer with strong experience in the direct-selling / MLM industry, particularly with commission-processing and incentive systems.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience working with Rocket U2 (UniData/Universe) environments, complex business rules, commission calculations, distributor/member hierarchies, and high-volume transactional data. This role will be responsible for developing, maintaining, optimizing, and supporting data solutions that power commission and incentive processing.

Key Responsibilities
● Design, develop, maintain, and optimize applications and data processes using UniData / Universe.
● Work closely with business and functional teams to understand direct-selling compensation plans and translate requirements into technical solutions.

● Develop and maintain commission-processing logic, including:
● Sales and order-based commissions
● Bonuses and incentives
● Rank-based compensation
● Volume calculations
● Qualification rules
● Overrides and residual commissions
● Adjustments, reversals, and clawbacks
● Period-end commission processing

● Work with distributor/member hierarchies, genealogy structures, sponsor relationships, and organizational trees.
● Develop and optimize UniQuery, UniBasic, dictionaries, stored procedures, and batch processes.
● Perform data extraction, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and loading across operational and reporting systems.
● Troubleshoot commission-processing issues and investigate discrepancies between source transactions and calculated payouts.
● Support month-end/pay-period commission runs and ensure accurate and timely processing.
● Develop reconciliation and audit processes to validate commission calculations and financial outputs.
● Analyze and improve performance of large UniData / Universe files and batch processes.
● Integrate UniData / Universe data with external applications, databases, APIs, reporting platforms, and downstream systems.
● Participate in production support, root-cause analysis, incident resolution, and performance tuning.
● Maintain technical documentation for data structures, compensation rules, interfaces, and processing workflows.
● Collaborate with QA teams to develop test scenarios covering complex compensation-plan rules and edge cases.

Required Qualifications:
● 8+ years of experience in UniData / Universe development and data engineering.
● Hands-on experience with UniBasic / UniQuery and UniData or Universe databases.
● Proven experience in the direct-selling, MLM, network-marketing, or distributor-based business domain.
● Strong experience working with commission-processing, compensation, incentive, or payout systems.
● Understanding of distributor hierarchies, sales volume, qualifications, ranks, bonuses, and compensation plans.
● Strong SQL and relational database skills.
● Experience with data integration, ETL/ELT, batch processing, and data reconciliation.
● Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
● Experience supporting production systems and resolving data/commission discrepancies.
● Ability to understand complex business rules and convert them into reliable technical solutions.
Preferred Qualifications
● Experience with Rocket U2 / Rocket UniData / Universe environments.
● Experience migrating or integrating UniData / Universe with modern cloud or relational data platforms.
● Experience with APIs, web services, or middleware integrations.
● Experience with Python, scripting, or other modern data-engineering technologies.
● Experience with reporting and BI platforms.
● Knowledge of financial reconciliation, audit controls, and payout processing.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

Key Skills

Technical:
UniData, Universe, UniBasic, UniQuery, SQL, ETL/ELT, data modeling, batch processing, data integration, APIs, database performance tuning
Domain:
Direct Selling, MLM, Network Marketing, Distributor Management, Compensation Plans, Commission Processing, Incentive Calculations, Bonus Processing, Genealogy/Hierarchy, Payout Reconciliation Success Measures
Accurate and timely commission processing
Reliable and performant UniData / Universe applications
Reduction in commission-processing errors and manual reconciliation
Effective resolution of production and data-quality issues
Successful implementation of new compensation-plan rules
High data integrity across transactional, commission, and reporting systems

Ideal Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate is not simply a UniData developer. We are specifically looking for someone who understands how direct-selling compensation systems work and has previously worked on the technical implementation or support of commission calculation and payout processing. Experience with complex compensation plans, distributor hierarchies, volume calculations, bonuses, adjustments, and commission-period processing will be highly valued.

title: Investigation Associate, Relay Product Excellence
description:
At Amazon, we move fast — and keeping our transportation network safe and compliant requires sharp, detail-oriented investigators who thrive on data. As an Investigation Associate, you'll sit at the intersection of risk management and identity verification, working through cases methodically using standard operating procedures while maintaining the speed and accuracy our operations demand.
Your day-to-day will involve reviewing and verifying identities across multiple processes, spotting inconsistencies, and resolving issues as per SOP. This role suits someone who finds satisfaction in pattern recognition, clear processes, and measurable outcomes.
We're looking for candidates with a background in transportation or risk management who can bring analytical rigour to high-volume investigative work. You should be comfortable working in a 24×7 rotating shift environment with flexible weekly offs — our network never sleeps, and neither does our commitment to safety.

1. Conduct investigations as per SOP

4. Knowledge to systematically escalate problems or variance in the information

6. Participate in ad-hoc projects and assignments as necessary

Serve as a key technical contributor for tariff classification and preferential trade program qualification across imported and exported home appliance products, components, and service parts. The role will work in close partnership with the company's current service providers who support these processes, supporting the continued development and maintenance of classification procedures, documentation standards, precedent files, and FTA (Free Trade Agreement) qualification processes while ensuring continuity and quality across the combined team.

Position

Senior Trade Analyst, Tariff Classification & Free Trade Agreements

Location

USA, Louisville, KY

How You'll Create Possibilities

Key Responsibilities
Tariff Classification - approximately 60%

  • Determine, review, and document HTSUS, Schedule B, and ECCN classifications for finished appliances subassemblies, components, and service parts, in coordination with the company's supporting service providers.
  • Build and maintain the internal classification database of records, including part-level attributes, GRI rationale, and supporting technical documentation.
  • Apply the General Rules of Interpretation, Section and Chapter Notes, Explanatory Notes, CBP rulings (CROSS), and court decisions to complex determinations, particularly composite goods, sets, and parts-versus-articles analysis.
  • Assess Section 232, Section 301, and other special trade program applicability, including derivative steel and aluminum content and country-of-melt/smelt-and-pour requirements.
  • Prepare binding ruling requests and classification analyses supporting prior disclosures.
  • Support the development and continuous improvement of classification SOPs, review cadence, and NPI processes in partnership with Engineering, Sourcing, and Product Management.
  • Review work performed by supporting service providers for accuracy and consistency and escalate complex issues as needed.

Free Trade Agreements - approximately 30%

  • Qualify products under USMCA and other applicable agreements using tariff shift, regional value content, and de minimis analysis.
  • Manage supplier solicitation, certification collection, validity tracking, and annual recertification.
  • Perform bill-of-material level origin analysis and maintain audit-ready qualification files.
  • Issue certifications of origin to customers and respond to customer and CBP origin verifications.
  • Evaluate qualification opportunities for duty savings and support duty engineering analysis.

Governance and Collaboration - approximately 10%

  • Coordinate with supporting service providers to align processes, documentation standards, and data quality.
  • Support classification aspects of post-entry activity, including protests, Post Summary Corrections, reconciliation, and CF-28 responses.
  • Train internal stakeholders and maintain reasonable care documentation.
  • Support internal audit and periodic testing of classification accuracy.

What You'll Bring to Our Team

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Five or more years of hands-on HTSUS classification experience in a manufacturing, retail, or customs brokerage environment.
  • Demonstrated FTA qualification experience, USMCA strongly preferred, including BOM-level regional value content and tariff shift analysis.
  • Working knowledge of ACE, CBP rulings research, and entry documentation.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, bills of material, and technical specifications.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with external service providers and cross-functional internal teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Licensed Customs Broker (LCB) and/or Certified Customs Specialist (CCS).
  • Home appliance, consumer durables, or electro-mechanical product experience.
  • Section 232 steel and aluminum derivative experience.
  • Global Trade Management system experience (Oracle GTM, SAP GTS, Descartes, e2open).
  • Classification experience in additional jurisdictions, particularly Mexico, Canada, or the European Union.

title: AI Driven Full Stack Developer
description:
Join Aurora Live in building Europe’s most wanted executive network — and the proprietary digital platforms behind it.

Aurora Live is a fast-growing European company with operations in 10+ markets, a team of 300+ professionals, and annual revenue of over €40M. Our ambition is high, and so is our commitment to creating software that directly improves both customer experience and employee experience.

Digital services are central to how we create value. From customer-facing solutions to internal tools that empower our commercial teams, our software plays a critical role in our success. With the exception of our CRM, nearly all of these applications have been built in-house, reflecting our strong belief in proprietary technology as a strategic asset.

As we grow, we are looking for an AI-Driven Full Stack Developer to join our Helsinki team. In this role, you will help shape the next generation of Aurora Live’s digital products and services, combining full-stack expertise with modern AI-driven ways of building smarter, more impactful solutions. We have international software team of 20+ members, of which 8 are in Finland. We use agile methods to organize our work and aim for continuous improvement as a team.

Your role:

Role

As a Full Stack Developer, you’ll build, maintain, and enhance our platforms, working with a variety of technologies. You’ll contribute at every stage of the development lifecycle – from design to deployment – while improving both new and existing features. In this role, you’ll:

  • Take part in functional and technical design discussions
  • Architect and design technical solutions
  • Write software requirements
  • Write clean and functional code for both front-end and back-end
  • Evaluate and improve existing and AI generated code
  • Have ambition to create exceptional user experiences
  • Collaborate closely with the development team to elevate our technical standards
  • Impact the stability, performance, and usability of our products for customers and internal users alike

What You’ll Bring

  • Extensive experience with both front-end and back-end development
  • Proficiency with web technologies (TypeScript/JavaScript, HTML, CSS) and at least one front-end framework (e.g. React, Angular or Vue) and libraries
  • Hands-on expertise with server-side technologies such as Node.js, and the ability to learn new tools and languages
  • Strong experience with relational databases (MySQL,MariaDB).
  • Solid experience with APIs, GraphQL.
  • Familiarity with AWS Cloud platforms and Services (EC2, ECS, Lambda, VPC, API Gateway, Route53…)
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices (Git, Docker, AWS CI/CD pipelines).
  • Experience with CRM systems (like HubSpot) and automation technologies (like n8n or Robot Framework) is a plus
  • Experience with AI driven development is a plus (e.g. Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Google Antigravity)
  • A good eye for layout aesthetics and design.
  • Analytical mindset with excellent time management
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills
  • Passion for automation and finding efficiencies—aiming to automate tasks wherever possible
  • A team-oriented mindset, eager to share knowledge and collaborate with others

What We Offer

  • Growth and learning:From day one, you’ll benefit from a structured onboarding program and continuous coaching ensuring you’re always developing.
  • Recharge & Thrive:We care about your well-being and want you to stay energized both inside and outside of work. That’s why you can earn up to 12 extra vacation days each year and enjoy local perks such as gym and massage discounts, along with lunch vouchers, culture and sport benefit, social gatherings and events.
  • We win together:Collaboration is our driving force, and every success is shared. That’s why we love bringing people together through company trips, international events, and local office celebrations — whether it’s hitting the slopes in Levi, running the Berlin Marathon together, or celebrating milestones across our offices in Europe.
  • Annual company trip:Every summer, all employees from our different offices come together in Finland for an exciting time - a mix of team building, knowledge exchange, and celebrations.
  • Global Community & Diversity:Diversity is part of our DNA. With colleagues from over 50 nationalities, you’ll join an international community where every culture, perspective, and background fuels innovation and success.

At Aurora Live, we’re transforming the way leaders connect, collaborate, and grow.

Working with us means being part of an international, fast-paced, and purpose-driven company, where ambition meets action and every idea can make an impact.

Our teams bring together smart, curious, and driven individuals who love what they do — connecting visionary leaders, shaping industries, and celebrating success along the way.

Ready to be part of something extraordinary? Join us and help shape the future of business connections.

title: Senior VP, Deposits Product Management
description:
Company: 1011 United Overseas Bank Ltd

About UOB

United Overseas Bank Limited (UOB) is a leading bank in Asia with a global network of more than 500 branches and offices in 19 countries and territories in Asia Pacific, Europe and North America. In Asia, we operate through our head office in Singapore and banking subsidiaries in China, Indonesia, Malaysia and Thailand, as well as branches and offices. Our history spans more than 80 years. Over this time, we have been guided by our values – Honorable, Enterprising, United and Committed. This means we always strive to do what is right, build for the future, work as one team and pursue long-term success. It is how we work, consistently, be it towards the company, our colleagues or our customers.

Job Description

Role Summary

The Senior Vice President, Deposits Product Management is responsible for defining and driving the strategic direction, growth, and profitability of the Bank's deposits portfolio. The incumbent will lead the management and development of Affluent and Pricing Deposit products, overseeing portfolio performance, product innovation, customer acquisition strategies, pricing optimization, and customer experience across all channels.

The role partners closely with Retail Banking, Digital Banking, Sales & Distribution, Customer Franchise, Risk, Compliance, Operations, and Technology teams to deliver sustainable business growth while ensuring strong governance and regulatory compliance.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Product Leadership

  • Develop and execute the deposits product strategy to drive portfolio growth, customer acquisition, market share expansion, and profitability.
  • Lead the strategic management of Affluent and Pricing Deposit products, ensuring alignment with the Bank's overall retail banking and customer franchise objectives.
  • Identify emerging market trends, customer needs, and competitive opportunities to develop innovative product propositions and enhance customer value.
  • Drive the product roadmap and long-term growth strategy for the deposits business.

Business & Financial Management

  • Own and drive product P&L, balance growth, revenue generation, pricing strategy, and overall portfolio profitability.
  • Formulate and implement pricing, promotional, and acquisition strategies to optimize customer acquisition, retention, and wallet share.
  • Monitor business performance, customer trends, and portfolio analytics to identify growth opportunities and recommend strategic actions.
  • Establish and manage key business performance indicators and deliver targeted business outcomes.

Customer Journey & Digital Transformation

  • Drive end-to-end customer journey enhancements across onboarding, servicing, engagement, and transactional experiences.
  • Partner with Digital Banking and Technology teams to accelerate digital adoption and improve customer experience.
  • Champion customer-centric design and innovation to improve acquisition, engagement, and retention outcomes.

Stakeholder Management & Business Partnership

  • Work closely with Channels, Sales & Distribution, Customer Segmentation, Marketing, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Technology teams to deliver business objectives.
  • Influence and align senior stakeholders on strategic initiatives, business priorities, and investment decisions.
  • Partner with frontline sales teams to drive product penetration, customer acquisition, and portfolio growth.

Governance, Risk & Regulatory Management

  • Serve as the Product Owner with accountability for end-to-end product governance and lifecycle management.
  • Ensure products, processes, and distribution channels comply with regulatory requirements, internal policies, and risk frameworks.
  • Lead product reviews, governance forums, policy updates, and risk assessments to maintain a strong control environment.
  • Manage audit, compliance, and regulatory engagements relating to the deposits portfolio.

Transformation & Project Management

  • Lead strategic and regulatory initiatives affecting the deposits business.
  • Oversee large-scale business transformation, digitalization, and process improvement projects.
  • Ensure effective execution through close collaboration with business and support functions, delivering projects on time, within scope, and aligned with business objectives.

People Leadership

  • Provide leadership, coaching, and development to product managers and cross-functional teams.
  • Foster a high-performance culture focused on innovation, customer experience, collaboration, and execution excellence.

Job Requirements

  • Degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Banking, Marketing, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 12-15 years of banking experience, with significant experience in Deposits Product Management, Retail Banking, Consumer Banking, or Affluent Banking.
  • Proven track record in managing large deposits portfolios and delivering strong business growth and profitability.
  • Deep understanding of deposits products, pricing strategies, balance sheet management, customer acquisition, and product economics.
  • Demonstrated experience leading strategic product initiatives, digital transformation, and customer journey optimization programs.
  • Strong commercial acumen with experience managing P&L and business performance.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills with the ability to engage senior leadership and cross-functional partners.
  • Strong understanding of banking regulations, governance frameworks, and risk management principles.
  • Proven leadership experience in managing high-performing teams and delivering complex business initiatives.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience managing Affluent Banking, Wealth-linked Deposits, CASA, Fixed Deposits, and Pricing Deposit portfolios.
  • Strong knowledge of customer segmentation, digital banking ecosystems, and customer lifecycle management.
  • Experience leading regional or multi-market product initiatives will be advantageous.

Additional Requirements

title: Software Engineer - Build Platform
description:
At Optiver, the velocity of our software development is a critical part of our competitive advantage. Our ability to compete depends on how quickly new ideas can move from insight to production. The Developer Experience team is a strategic engineering function with a clear mandate: improve the development lifecycle across the company in ways that accelerate delivery and reduce our time to market. We build the tools, systems, and platforms that shape how software is developed at Optiver.

The Build Platform sits at the heart of that lifecycle. Every change an engineer makes flows through it. When builds are fast, correct, and reproducible, engineers stay in flow, receive fast and trustworthy feedback, and shipping changes becomes routine. When builds are slow or unreliable, every team in the company pays the tax, one slow feedback loop at a time.

We’re looking for a strong engineer with a passion for improving developer productivity, a deep interest in build systems, and the experience to design and operate platforms at scale. You’ll join a growing global Developer Experience team and help shape the future of how software is built, tested, and delivered at Optiver, enabling both engineers and agents to move from idea to production-ready software with greater speed and confidence.

What you’ll do

  • Shape the future of C++ builds at Optiver by designing and rolling out modern build systems that accelerate build times, improve reliability, and create a more consistent developer experience;
  • Develop common build libraries, reusable CI/CD pipelines, and container images used across the company;
  • Build observability into our platform so we can measure performance, reliability and adoption, and use that data to guide further improvements;
  • Improve build performance at scale through incremental execution, caching, dependency analysis and efficient scheduling;
  • Design workflows that enable agents to compile, test, diagnose failures, and validate changes reliably with minimal human intervention;
  • Work closely with engineering teams to understand where existing workflows create friction and turn those problems into scalable solutions;
  • Help teams adopt new tools and working practices, balancing standardisation with the needs of different codebases and engineering groups;
  • Stay current with industry trends and emerging tools in the developer experience and build systems space, helping guide our adoption of best-in-class solutions.

See the team lead's opinion on why DevEx matters here.

Who you are

  • You are a strong software engineer with deep experience in C++ build systems and developer tooling;
  • You have hands-on experience designing, adopting, or operating modern build systems such as Bazel, Buck2, Pants, or Gradle, ideally including migration from established tooling;
  • You have a deep understanding of build system concepts including incremental builds, caching, reproducibility, dependency graphs, remote execution, and artifact management;
  • You are skilled at diagnosing performance and reliability issues across the local development and continuous integration lifecycle, using data and observability to guide improvements;
  • You have significant experience with CI/CD platforms such as GitHub Actions, Buildkite, Jenkins, or similar, and understand how to design reliable, scalable pipelines and the infrastructure that supports them;
  • You hold a deep understanding of the end-to-end lifecycle of software development from ideation to deployment;
  • You have experience building tools and workflows around source control platforms such as GitHub and GitLab;
  • You are passionate about developer productivity and have a track record of delivering meaningful improvements to the software development lifecycle.

Who we are

At Optiver, our mission is to continuously improve the market. By providing liquidity and accurate pricing in various financial instruments, to multiple exchanges across the world, we participate in the safeguarding of healthy and efficient markets.

What you’ll get

You’ll join a culture of collaboration and excellence, where you’ll be surrounded by curious thinkers and creative problem solvers. Motivated by a passion for continuous improvement, you’ll thrive in a supportive, high-performing environment alongside talented colleagues, working collectively to tackle the toughest problems in the financial markets.

In addition, you’ll receive:

  • A performance-based bonus structure, enabling all of our employees to benefit from our global profit pool.
  • 27 paid vacation days plus all UK public holidays.
  • Daily breakfast and lunch, along with support on commuting expenses.
  • Private medical insurance, pension scheme, and ClassPass fitness membership.
  • Training and continuous learning opportunities, including access to conferences and tech events.
  • International transfer opportunities for global career growth.

How to apply:

Apply directly via the form below. If you have any questions feel free to contact our Recruitment team via our recruitment inquiry form. Please note, we cannot accept applications via email for data protection reasons. Kindly note that we do not require assistance from third-parties including agencies in the recruitment of this role.

Optiver is committed to diversity and inclusion.

title: Senior Product Owner  - BESS and Data Platform
description:
POSITION OVERVIEW

We are seeking a highly technical, execution-driven Senior Product Owner to lead our customer’s BESS product lines & Data Platform product portfolio.

In this role, you will bridge the gap between strategic product vision, energy storage domain expertise, advanced analytics, and software engineering execution.

You will not simply manage a backlog; you will drive the development and delivery of intelligent battery optimization capabilities, operational analytics platforms, fleet intelligence solutions, and data-driven software products that maximize the value of Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS).

The ideal candidate possesses strong knowledge of energy storage technologies, software platforms, controls systems, cloud-based data solutions, and Agile product delivery. Equally important are your leadership capabilities, including stakeholder management, roadmap prioritization, cross-functional collaboration, and translating complex technical concepts into customer and business value.

This role will work closely with Product Management, System Intelligence, Controls Engineering, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, Services, and Customer Success teams to deliver market-leading BESS product line’s capabilities and scalable data platform solutions

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. BESS product lines’ Product Strategy & Intelligent Controls

  • Serve as the product leader for BESS product line’s initiatives focused on improving battery performance, lifecycle optimization, operational efficiency, and customer value.

  • Partner with Product Managers and System Intelligence teams to identify and prioritize intelligent control features and software-enabled value propositions.

  • Drive product direction for advanced energy optimization capabilities, including:

    • State-of-Health informed controls

    • Fleet performance optimization

    • Battery lifecycle management

    • Energy availability optimization

    • Operational intelligence solutions

    • Data-driven automation and decision support systems

  • Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends within energy storage, battery management, system intelligence, and renewable energy software ecosystems.

2. Product Lifecycle Ownership & Technical Execution

  • Convert business capabilities, design studies, and validated BESS product line concepts into implementation-ready product requirements and engineering workstreams.

  • Author and manage epics, features, and user stories that support software delivery teams responsible for BESS solutions.

  • Act as the primary bridge between System Intelligence teams, domain experts, and software implementation teams.

  • Support engineering teams throughout the complete product lifecycle, including:

    • Requirements definition

    • Solution design

    • Development planning

    • Feature implementation

    • Validation and testing

    • Release readiness

    • Production deployment

  • Ensure delivered solutions align with approved business objectives, design intent, and customer outcomes.

3. Data Platform Strategy & Analytics Enablement

  • Own product requirements for enterprise-scale operational data platforms supporting global BESS fleets.

  • Define capabilities for data ingestion, telemetry collection, data processing, analytics, reporting, visualization, and machine learning enablement.

  • Collaborate with Data Engineering teams to establish scalable, secure, and reliable data architectures.

  • Drive initiatives focused on:

    • Fleet intelligence

    • Predictive analytics

    • Operational health monitoring

    • Asset performance management

    • Customer-facing insights and reporting

  • Ensure data platform roadmaps support scalability, cybersecurity, observability, data governance, and long-term product sustainability.

4. Product Vision & Backlog Management (Agile Execution)

  • Own, prioritize, and maintain the BESS product lines’ and Data Platform product backlog.

  • Translate strategic business priorities into detailed epics, features, stories, and acceptance criteria.

  • Lead Agile ceremonies including:

    • PI Planning

    • Sprint Planning

    • Backlog Refinement

    • Sprint Reviews

    • Release Planning

  • Define clear Acceptance Criteria and Definition of Done (DoD) for all product deliverables.

  • Manage dependencies across software, controls, analytics, and platform teams.

  • Balance new feature development, technical debt reduction, system modernization, and platform reliability initiatives.

  • Ensure engineering teams maintain a healthy, prioritized, and continuously refined backlog.

5. Stakeholder Management & Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Act as the primary interface between Product Management, System Intelligence, Controls Engineering, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Services, and executive leadership.

  • Facilitate product discovery sessions, roadmap reviews, business requirement workshops, and technical prioritization discussions.

  • Translate highly technical concepts into meaningful business narratives suitable for senior leadership and customer-facing audiences.

  • Drive alignment across globally distributed teams while balancing competing priorities and delivery objectives.

  • Foster strong collaboration between software engineers, battery experts, data scientists, solution architects, and business stakeholders.

6. Business Value Realization & Product Success

  • Define and monitor KPIs measuring product adoption, operational impact, platform performance, and customer success.

  • Establish measurable outcomes for BESS product lines and analytics solutions.

  • Support business case development and value realization initiatives.

  • Use customer feedback, operational insights, and data analytics to continuously improve products and services.

  • Ensure delivered capabilities contribute to improved battery performance, enhanced reliability, operational efficiency, and differentiated customer value.

We are seeking a candidate who combines strong technical acumen with strategic product ownership and leadership capabilities.

Technical Expertise & Experience

Energy Storage & BESS

  • Strong experience with Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), Energy Management Systems (EMS), Battery Management Systems (BMS), or renewable energy technologies.

  • Understanding of battery performance characteristics, degradation mechanisms, operational optimization, and lifecycle management.

  • Familiarity with battery controls, dispatch strategies, state-of-charge management, and grid-connected energy systems.

Controls, Analytics & System Intelligence

  • Experience working with operational analytics, optimization algorithms, AI/ML-enabled systems, digital twins, or advanced monitoring solutions.

  • Understanding of telemetry systems, system intelligence platforms, and performance analytics frameworks.

    • Data ingestion pipelines

    • Streaming and batch processing architectures

    • API integrations

    • Data lakes and warehouses

  • Familiarity with cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.

Software Product Development

  • Hands-on experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, or equivalent Agile toolsets.

  • Ability to translate complex business requirements into technical specifications and engineering deliverables.

Leadership & Soft Skills

  • Stakeholder Management: Proven capability to manage diverse and conflicting priorities across multiple organizations.

description:

Every effort has been made to identify the essential functions of this position. However, it in no way states or implies that these are the only duties you will be required to perform. The omission of specific statements of duties does not exclude them from the position if the work is similar, related, or is an essential function of the position. Administrative Functions • Assist the Director of Nursing Services in directing the day-to-day functions of the nursing activities in accordance with current rules, regulations, and guidelines that govern the long-term care facility. • Participate in developing, maintaining, and updating written policies and procedures that govern the day-to-day functions of the nursing service department. • Ensure that reference material (i.e., PDR’S, regulations, professional standards of practice, etc.) maintained at the nurses’ stations is current. Recommend written material that will assist the nursing service department in meeting the day-to-day needs of the resident. • Ensure that the Nursing Service Procedures Manual is current and reflects the day-to-day nursing procedures performed in this facility. • Ensure that all nursing service personnel comply with the procedures set forth in the Nursing Service Procedures Manual. • Make written and oral reports/recommendations to the Director as necessary/required, concerning the operation of the nursing service department. • Periodically review the department’s policies, procedure manuals, job descriptions, etc. Make recommendations for revisions to the Director. • Assist in developing methods for coordinating nursing services with other resident services to ensure the continuity of the residents’ total regimen of care. • Ensure that all nursing service personnel are in compliance with their respective job descriptions. • Participate in the development, maintenance and implementation of the facility’s quality assurance program for the nursing service department. • Participate in facility surveys (inspections) made by authorized government agencies as requested by the Administrator or Director of Nursing Services. • Periodically review the resident’s written discharge plan. Participate in the updating of the resident’s written discharge plan as required. • Assist the Director in planning the nursing services portion of the resident’s discharge plan as necessary. • Meet with the nursing staff, as well as support personnel, in planning the department’s services, programs, and activities. • Admit, transfer, and discharge residents as required. • Complete accident/incident reports as necessary. • Interpret the department’s policies and procedures to personnel, residents, visitors, and government agencies as required. • Perform administrative duties such as completing medical forms, reports, evaluations, studies, charting, etc., asnecessary. • Agree not to disclose assigned user ID code and password for accessing resident/facility information and promptly report suspected or known violations of such disclosure to the Administrator. • Agree not to disclose resident’s protected health information and promptly report suspected or known violations of such disclosure to the Administrator. • Report any known or suspected unauthorized attempt to access facility’s information system. Committee Functions • Attend various committee meetings of the facility (i.e., Infection Control, Policy Advisory, Pharmaceutical, Quality Assessment, etc.) as required. • Assist in preparing written and/or oral reports of the nursing service programs and activities to submit to such committee(s) as directed. • Provide information to the Quality Assurance and Assessment Committee as requested. • Participate in developing the agenda for the Care Plan Committee meetings as necessary. • Participate in regularly scheduled reviews of the discharge plans and make such plans available to the Care Plan Committee as required or as may be necessary. • Implement recommendations from established committees as instructed by the Director. Personnel Functions • Ensure that a sufficient number of licensed practical and/or registered nurses are available for your tour of duty to ensure that quality care is maintained. • Ensure that a sufficient number of certified nursing assistants are available for your tour of duty to ensure that routine nursing care is provided to meet the daily nursing care needs of each resident. • Develop work assignments, and/or assist in completing and performing such tasks. • Delegate to each Charge Nurse the administrative authority, responsibility, and accountability necessary to perform his/her assigned duties. • Ensure that all nursing assistants are enrolled in or have graduated from an approved nursing assistant training program. • Ensure that all nurse aide trainees are under the direct supervision of a licensed nurse. • Make daily rounds of the nursing service department to ensure that all nursing service personnel are performing their work assignments in accordance with acceptable nursing standards. Report findings to the Director. • Monitor absenteeism to ensure that an adequate number of nursing care personnel are on duty at all times. Report problem areas to the Director. • Ensure that established policies and procedures, including dress codes, are followed by all departmental personnel. • Review complaints and grievances made or filed by department personnel. Make appropriate reports to the Director as required or as may be necessary. • Develop and maintain a good working rapport with inter-department personnel, as well as other departments within the facility to ensure that nursing services and activities can be adequately maintained to meet the needs of the residents. • Create and maintain an atmosphere of warmth, personal interest and positive emphasis, as well as a calm environment throughout the unit and shift. • Meet with your shift on a regularly scheduled basis to assist in identifying and correcting problem areas and/or to assist in the improvement of services. • Review and evaluate your department’s work force and make recommendations to the Director. • Participate in employee performance evaluations, determining your shift’s staffing requirements, and making recommendations to the Director concerning employee dismissals, transfers, etc. • Ensure that departmental disciplinary action is administered fairly and without regard to race, color, creed, national origin, age, sex, religion, handicap, or marital status. • Report occupational exposures to blood, body fluids, infectious materials, and hazardous chemicals in accordance with the facility’s policies and procedures governing accidents and incidents. • Report known or suspected incidents of fraud to the Administrator. • Ensure that departmental computer workstations left unattended are properly logged off or the password protected automatic screen-saver activates within established facility policy guidelines. Nursing Care Functions • Inform nursing service personnel of new admissions, their expected time of arrival, room assignment, etc. • Ensure that rooms are ready for new admissions. • Greet newly admitted residents upon admission. Escort them to their rooms as necessary • Make rounds with physicians as necessary. • Encourage attending physicians to record and sign progress notes, physicians’ orders, etc., on a timely basis and in accordance with current regulations. • Inform the Director when physician visits are not made in a timely manner. • Consult with the resident, his/her family, and the resident’s physician in planning the resident’s care, treatment, rehabilitation, etc., as necessary. • Notify the resident’s attending physician and next-of-kin when there is a change in the resident’s condition. • Visit residents on a daily basis in order to observe and evaluate each resident’s physical and emotional status. • Ensure that direct nursing care be provided by a licensed nurse, a certified nursing assistant, and/or a nurse aide trainee qualified to perform the procedure. • Review nurses’ notes to ensure that they are informative and descriptive of the nursing care being provided, that they reflect the resident’s response to the care, and that such care is provided in accordance with the resident’s wishes. • Provide direct nursing care as necessary. • Start IVs, obtain sputum, urine and other specimens for lab tests as ordered. • Take TPRs, blood pressures, etc., as necessary. • Admit, transfer and discharge residents as necessary. • Report problem areas to the Director. Assist in developing and implementing corrective action. • Keep the Director informed of the status of residents and other related matters through written/oral reports. • Assist the Charge Nurse in monitoring seriously ill residents. • Authorize the use of restraints when necessary and in accordance with our facilities policies and procedures. • Ensure that all RNs and LPNs on your shift comply with written procedures for the administration, storage, and control of medications and supplies. • Monitor medication passes and treatment schedules to ensure that medications are being administered as ordered and that treatments are provided as scheduled. • Review medication cards for completeness of information, accuracy in the transcription of physician orders, and adherence to stop order policies. • Inspect the nursing service treatment areas daily to ensure that they are maintained in a clean and safe manner. • Ensure that residents who are unable to call for help are checked frequently. • Meet with residents, and/or family members, as necessary. Report problems to the Director. • Assist in arranging transportation for discharged residents as necessary. • Inform family members of the death of the resident. • Call funeral homes when requested by the family. Staff Development • Participate in developing, planning, conducting, and scheduling in-service training classes that provide instructions on “how to do the job,” and ensure a well-educated nursing service department. • Assist the In-service Director/Educator in developing annual facility in-service training programs (e.g., OSHA, TB, HIPAA, Abuse Prevention, Safety, Infection Control, etc.). • Assist the Director in planning clinical supervision for nurse aide trainees. • Attend and participate in continuing education programs designed to keep you abreast of changes in your profession, as well as to maintain your license on a current status. Safety and Sanitation • Assist the Safety Officer in developing safety standards for the nursing service department as necessary. • Assist the Director and/or Infection Control Coordinator in identifying, evaluating, and classifying routine and jobrelated functions to ensure that tasks in which there is potential exposure to blood/body fluids are properly identified and recorded. • Ensure that all personnel performing tasks that involve potential exposure to blood/body fluids participate in appropriate in-service training programs prior to performing such tasks. • Ensure that an adequate supply of personal protective equipment is on hand and readily available to personnel who perform procedures that involve exposure to blood or body fluids. • Ensure that personnel follow established procedures for the use and disposal of personal protective equipment. • Monitor your shift’s personnel to ensure that they are following established safety regulations in the use of equipment and supplies. • Ensure that all nursing service personnel comply with established departmental policies and procedures. • Ensure that nursing service work areas (i.e., nurses’ stations, medicine preparation rooms, etc.) are maintained in a clean and sanitary manner. • Ensure that all resident care rooms, treatment areas, etc., are maintained in a clean, safe, and sanitary manner. • Ensure that nursing service personnel follow established handwashing and hand hygiene procedures. • Ensure that nursing service personnel participate in and conduct all fire safety and disaster preparedness drills in a safe and professional manner. • Participate in the development, implementation, and maintenance of the infection control program for monitoring communicable and/or infectious diseases among the residents and personnel. • Ensure that nursing service personnel follow established infection control procedures when isolation precautions become necessary. • Participate in the development, implementation and maintenance of the procedures for reporting hazardous conditions or equipment. • Ensure that all personnel wear and/or use safety equipment and supplies (e.g., back brace, mechanical lifts, etc.) when lifting or moving residents. • Report missing/illegible labels and MSDSs to the safety officer or other designated person. Equipment and Supply Functions • Recommend to the Director the equipment and supply needs of the department. • Ensure that an adequate stock level of medications, medical supplies, equipment, etc., is maintained on premises at all times to meet the needs of the resident. • Assist the Maintenance Director in developing a preventive maintenance program for maintaining the nursing service department’s equipment and supplies in a safe and operable manner. • Participate in the development and implementation of the procedures for the safe operation of all nursing service equipment. • Ensure that only trained and authorized personnel operate the nursing service department’s equipment. • Ensure that all personnel operate nursing service equipment in a safe manner. • Monitor nursing procedures to ensure that nursing service supplies are used in an efficient manner to avoid waste. • Ensure that appropriate MSDSs are on file for hazardous chemicals used in the nursing service department. Care Plan and Assessment Functions • Participate in the development of written preliminary and comprehensive assessments of the nursing needs of each resident as necessary. • Participate in the development of a written plan of care (preliminary and comprehensive) for each resident that identifies the problems/needs of the resident, indicates the care to be given, goals to be accomplished, and which professional service is responsible for each element of care. • Encourage the resident to participate in the development and review of his/her care plan. • Review resident care plans for appropriate resident goals, problems, approaches, and revisions based on nursing needs. • Ensure that all personnel involved in providing care to the resident are aware of the resident’s care plan. Ensure that nursing personnel refer to the resident’s care plan prior to administering daily care to the resident. • Review nurses’ notes to determine if the care plan is being followed. • Assist the Resident Assessment/Care Plan Coordinator in planning, scheduling, and revising the MDS, including the implementation of RAPs and Triggers. • Review resident’s medical and nursing treatments to ensure that they are provided in accordance with the resident’s care plan and wishes. Budget and Planning Functions • Keep abreast of economic conditions/situations, and recommend to the Director adjustments in nursing services that ensure the continued ability to provide quality care. • Recommend to the Director the equipment needs of the nursing service department. • Report suspected or known incidence of fraud relative to false billings, cost reports, kickbacks, etc. Supervisory Requirements Assist with the overall supervision of and management of the nursing staff. As RN, you are delegated the administrative authority, responsibility, and accountability necessary for carrying out your assigned duties. Qualification Education and/or Experience Must posess, as a minimum, a Nursing Degree an accredited college or university. Must have training in rehabilitative and restorative nursing practices. 2 years or more experience preferably in a long-term care facility. Language Skills Must be able to read, write, speak, and understand the English language. Ability to read technical procedures. Ability to read and comprehend policy and procedure manuals. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from managers and employees. Mathematical Skills Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios and proportions to practical situations. Reasoning Ability Must possess • the ability to make independent decisions when circumstances warrant such action with the ability to solve practical problems. • the ability to deal tactfully with personnel, residents, family members, visitors, government agencies/personnel, and the general public. • leadership and supervisory ability and the willingness to work harmoniously with and supervise other personnel. • the ability to plan, organize, develop, implement, and interpret the programs, goals, objectives, policies and procedures, etc., that are necessary for providing quality care. Must demonstrate the knowledge and skills necessary to provide care appropriate to the age-related needs of the residents served. Be a supportive team member, contribute to and be an example of team work and team concept. Must be knowledgeable of nursing and medical practices and procedures, as well as laws, regulations, and guidelines that pertain to nursing care facilities. Must have patience, tact, a cheerful disposition and enthusiasm, as well as the willingness to handle difficult residents. Must be willing to seek out new methods and principles and be willing to incorporate them into existing nursing practices. Must be able to relate information concerning a resident’s condition. Must not pose a direct threat to the health or safety of other individuals in the workplace. Certificates, Licenses, Registrations Must posess a current, unencumbered, active license to practice as an RN in this state. Current CPR certification. Knowledge and experience with PCC preferred. Must maintain all required continuing education/licensing. Must remain in good standing with the State Board of Nursing at all times. Physical Demands Must be able to move intermittently throughout the workday. Must be able to speak and write the English language in an understandable manner. Must be able to cope with the mental and emotional stress of the position. Must be able to see and hear or use prosthetics that will enable these senses to function adequately to ensure that the requirements of this position can be fully met. Must function independently, and have flexibility, personal integrity, and the ability to work effectively with residents, personnel, and support agencies. Must meet the general health requirements set forth by the policies of this facility, which include a medical and physical examination. Must be able to relate to and work with the ill, disabled, elderly, emotionally upset, and, at times, hostile people within the facility. Must be able to push, pull, move, and/or lift a minimum of 25 pounds to a minimum height of 5 feet and be able to push, pull, move, and/or carry such weight a minimum distance of 50 feet. May be necessary to assist in the evacuation of residents during emergency situations. Work Environment The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Works in office area(s) as well as throughout the nursing service area (i.e., drug rooms, nurses’ stations, resident rooms, etc.). Moves intermittently during working hours. Is subject to frequent interruptions. Is involved with residents, personnel, visitors, government agencies/personnel, etc., under all conditions and circumstances. Is subject to hostile and emotionally upset residents, family members, personnel, and visitors. Communicates with the medical staff, nursing personnel, and other department directors. Works beyond normal working hours and on weekends and holidays when necessary. Is subject to call back during emergency conditions (e.g., severe weather, evacuation, post-disaster, etc.). Is involved in community/civic health matters/projects as appropriate. Attends and participates in continuing educational programs. Is subject to injury from falls, burns from equipment, odors, etc., throughout the workday, as well as reactions from dust, disinfectants, tobacco smoke, and other air contaminants. Is subject to exposure to infectious waste, diseases, conditions, etc., including TB and the AIDS and Hepatitis B viruses. May be subject to the handling of and exposure to hazardous chemicals. Maintains a liaison with the residents, their families, support departments, etc., to adequately plan for the residents’ needs. title: Field Sales Engineer
description:
Hyve Company Overview

Hyve Solutions transforms complex engineering challenges into production reality for technology innovators building AI, cloud, and connected infrastructure. As a US-based manufacturing partner, the company rapidly delivers fast, agile execution through dep technical partnerships and co-innovation, and supply chain clarity. Hyve’s integrated ODM, CM, and SI capabilities eliminate vendor complexity while accelerating time-to-market with single-partner accountability from design through scale. The company co-innovates with deep engineering expertise, treating customer success as its own while building tomorrow's digital infrastructure.



About the job

As a Networking Field Sales Engineer, you will report directly to the Manager, Networking Field Sales Engineering. This role involves working closely with leading the sales organization and our major hyperscalers customers to drive design and sales activities, supporting sales teams, and ensuring customer satisfaction through technical expertise and effective communication. The position requires a blend of technical knowledge, sales experience, and interpersonal skills to drive business growth and meet revenue targets. As the perfect candidate:

You will (List 5-7 primary responsibilities and day-to-day aspects)

  • Lead design activities and drive sales, design and planning.

  • Determine business and technical requirements and ensure effective communication of proposed recommendations to senior management.

  • Present products and technical proposals to end-users during consulting engagements to address their often-complex requirements, design value driven architectures and explain the application and ROI of these solutions.

  • Provide internal direction during RFQ and NPI phase on integrated rack design (elevation, cabling, BOM components).

  • Support the sales team by delivering compelling recommendations which directly results in the closing of new sales.

  • Ensure revenue quota, deployment and service objectives are met while maintaining a high level of prospect/customer satisfaction.

  • Assist in the development of sales strategies and solutions to help ensure objectives are met.

  • Act as technical point of contact for prospects, customers and the sales team.

  • Provide follow-up support in disseminating technical information on specific applications.

  • Research and write the responses to technical sections of RFI/RFP’s.

  • Form and maintain relationships with client’s technical staff to identify new opportunities.

  • Lead the gathering of architecture, design and presentation of solutions to meet the prospect’s needs.

  • Drive and support pre-sales pilots, demonstrations, PoCs, evaluation and benchmarks.

You have (List 3-7 skills, qualifications, and experiences such as education, industry, domain knowledge, technical skills)

title: Senior Software Developer
description:
Cavtera builds digital solutions that connect real-world operations with data, software, and decision‑making. We work closely with clients to understand how their businesses operate on the ground, then translate those workflows into scalable applications and data systems using Palantir Foundry.

Our team operates with the pace, ownership, and adaptability of a startup while solving complex operational problems for established businesses. We work directly alongside our clients, from the field to the executive level, to build technology that delivers measurable improvements to how their businesses operate.

The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Software Developer to join Cavtera’s growing development team.

As a Senior Software Developer, you’ll be a technical leader within an engagement team, responsible for the architecture and delivery of complex digital solutions on Palantir Foundry. You’ll balance high‑level system design with hands‑on development, client‑facing technical leadership, and mentorship of other developers.

We’re looking for someone with approximately 5-8 years of professional software development experience who is comfortable taking technical ownership of complex engagements. You’ll help set the technical direction of the team, make architecture decisions, work directly with client stakeholders and executives, and ensure the solutions we build are scalable, reliable, and maintainable.

This is a strong fit for someone who enjoys solving ambiguous operational problems, designing systems rather than just individual features, and helping other developers become stronger engineers.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead system architecture: Own the technical design of complex client engagements, ensuring solutions are modular, performant, maintainable, and scalable.
  • Set the standard for data engineering: Design and optimize complex SQL, Python, and TypeScript data models and pipelines, while establishing strong practices around pipeline health and reliability.
  • Own ontology architecture: Guide the design and long‑term health of Object Types, Links, and Actions so the client’s digital model accurately reflects complex business operations.
  • Lead cross‑stack technical strategy: Shape the architecture of Foundry, OSDK, web, and mobile applications, including reliable bi‑directional data flow for field operations.
  • Lead strategic discovery: Work directly with clients on‑site to understand complex operational challenges, identify high‑value opportunities, and surface technical risks early.
  • Act as a technical advisor: Partner with client stakeholders and executives to translate long‑term business objectives into practical technical roadmaps.
  • Validate solutions before deployment: Ensure solutions meet high standards for technical quality, field usability, reliability, and architectural integrity before they reach end users.
  • Mentor other developers: Support intermediate and junior developers through code reviews, pair programming, architecture guidance, and hands‑on technical mentorship.
  • Establish engineering standards: Help create and refine Cavtera’s technical SOPs, modular design patterns, and internal engineering guides.
  • Drive code quality: Set and uphold architectural patterns and coding standards across the engagement team to support long‑term maintainability.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5-8 years of professional software development experience.
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript, Python, and SQL.
  • Deep knowledge of database design, data modelling, and system integration.
  • Experience designing and delivering complex production systems.
  • Strong architectural judgment, with the ability to evaluate trade‑offs and design for scalability and maintainability.
  • Experience leading technical work across multiple developers or a project team.
  • Strong problem‑solving skills — you are comfortable taking ambiguous business or operational problems and turning them into structured technical solutions.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to explain technical trade‑offs to non‑technical audiences and senior stakeholders.
  • Experience mentoring developers through technical guidance, code reviews, and collaborative problem‑solving.
  • A high degree of autonomy and comfort making consequential technical decisions.
  • Willingness to periodically travel to client sites for discovery, implementation, and technical leadership.

Nice To Have

  • Experience with Palantir Foundry or another enterprise data/application platform.
  • Experience with React, React Native, or other modern web/mobile frameworks.
  • Experience with ontology‑driven or domain‑driven system design.
  • Experience leading technical discovery or architecture workshops with clients.
  • Experience working directly with executives or senior business stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Experience with modern CI/CD and DevOps practices.
  • Proficiency in Python.

Salary Range

$120,000 – $150,000 CAD

Compensation is commensurate with experience. The final offer will be determined based on the candidate’s specific skills, technical proficiency, and relevant industry experience.
