title: Senior Software Development Engineer (US Federal)
description:
Your work days are brighter here.

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.

About the Team

Your work matters here. At Workday Government, we focus on outcomes that serve a larger mission. Our work supports U.S. federal agencies as they modernize and transform their full employee lifecycle experience and finance operations.

You will join a highly motivated, collaborative engineering team that thrives on teamwork, open communication, and shared problem-solving. Working with modern technologies like Kubernetes, Terraform, and Docker, our goal is to partner closely to build resilient, ultra-performant systems that our customers can depend on. In this role, you will lead efforts in troubleshooting complex performance issues, analyzing capacity forecasting needs, and driving cloud cost management and optimization. We are looking for driven engineers who take genuine pride in their craft, value cross-team collaboration, take ownership of initiatives, and consistently deliver impactful outcomes.

The work isn’t theoretical. It’s operational. It’s high-impact. And it demands technical rigor, strong teamwork, and long-term thinking.

About the Role

This role will support one or more direct or indirect contracts with the U.S. Federal Government which, due to federal government security requirements, mandates that all Workday personnel working on the contracts be United States citizens (naturalized or native).

Location Note:

May be required to be on site at client locations in the DC, MD, and VA (DMV) area.

Role Overview:

As a Sr. Performance Engineer (Sr. Software Development Engineer), you will play a pivotal role in optimizing Workday’s Kubernetes platform and cloud infrastructure in AWS GovCloud. You will lead deep-dive performance troubleshooting, drive capacity forecasting models, and manage cloud infrastructure cost optimization. By establishing robust performance telemetry and load testing strategies, you will ensure our systems remain fast, scalable, cost-efficient, and resilient in air-gapped environments.

You have a growth mindset and thrive in a collaborative, outcome-driven environment where cross-team partnership is key. You will be part of a team promoting a diverse and inclusive culture where you and your teammates are energized, engaged, and excited to solve complex engineering challenges together every day.

Responsibilities:

  • Performance Engineering & Troubleshooting: Apply deep expertise in distributed systems to diagnose, profile, and resolve complex performance bottlenecks, latency spikes, and resource constraints across Kubernetes workloads in AWS GovCloud.

  • Capacity Forecasting & Planning: Build predictive capacity models, analyze system usage trends, and execute stress and load testing to ensure platforms scale seamlessly under peak federal workloads.

  • Cloud Cost Management & Optimization: Track cloud resource utilization, right-size infrastructure, and implement FinOps strategies using AWS and Kubernetes tools to optimize infrastructure spend without compromising performance or security.

  • Performance Telemetry & Observability: Build, maintain, and optimize APM tools, distributed tracing, and capacity alerting frameworks to detect performance degradations before they impact end users.

  • Infrastructure & Automation: Utilize Terraform, Terragrunt, Docker, AWS, and Argo CD to automate infrastructure provisioning, auto-scaling policies, and continuous delivery pipelines.

  • Air-Gapped Systems Optimization: Conduct performance testing, tuning, and capacity planning tailored specifically to air-gapped deployment methodologies and isolated cloud environments.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with software developers, security leaders, and platform engineers to establish performance benchmarks, conduct design reviews, and foster performance-aware architecture across teams.

  • Knowledge Sharing & Mentorship: Author technical performance reports, share capacity forecasting insights, and mentor team members on performance profiling and troubleshooting techniques.

About You

Clearance & Eligibility Requirements:

  • U.S. Citizenship: Required due to federal government contract requirements.

  • Security Clearance: Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government TS/SCI security clearance with CI Polygraph. An active TS/SCI w/ CI Poly is strongly preferred.

Basic Qualifications (Senior/ P4):

  • Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience building, scaling, and maintaining production cloud infrastructure, DevOps pipelines, or platform engineering systems.

  • Infrastructure as Code: Proven proficiency (3+ years) with infrastructure automation tools such as Terraform or Terragrunt.

  • CI/CD & GitOps: Hands-on experience (3+ years) managing continuous delivery pipelines using tools like Argo CD, Jenkins, or GitLab CI.

  • Software Development: Proficiency in (3+ years) modern scripting or programming languages, with a preference for Go or Python.

  • Technical Leadership: Demonstrated ability (3+ years) to independently lead technical initiatives, troubleshoot distributed systems, and mentor junior engineers.

Basic Qualifications (Mid-Level/ P3):

  • Experience: 3+ years of hands-on experience building, scaling, and maintaining production cloud infrastructure, DevOps pipelines, or platform engineering systems.

  • Infrastructure as Code: Proven proficiency (2+ years) with infrastructure automation tools such as Terraform or Terragrunt.

  • CI/CD & GitOps: Hands-on experience (2+ years) managing continuous delivery pipelines using tools like Argo CD, Jenkins, or GitLab CI.

  • Software Development: Proficiency in (2+ years) modern scripting or programming languages, with a preference for Go or Python.

  • Technical Leadership: Demonstrated ability (1+ years) to independently lead technical initiatives, troubleshoot distributed systems, and mentor junior engineers.

Other Qualifications (preferred):

  • Kubernetes & AWS: Deep production experience managing containerized workloads in AWS (ideally AWS GovCloud) using Kubernetes and Docker.

  • Air-Gapped Systems: Practical experience implementing or managing air-gapped deployment methodologies and isolated cloud architectures.

  • Observability & Telemetry: Background in building robust monitoring, logging, and alerting systems for distributed platforms (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, etc).

  • Security & Compliance: Familiarity with federal security frameworks (e.g., FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, Zero Trust architecture).

  • Certifications: DoD 8570/8140 compliance at IAT Level II or higher (e.g., CompTIA Security+, CySA+, CASP+) along with a current Computing Environment credential.

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent military / practical engineering experience in lieu of a degree).


Workday Pay Transparency Statement

The annualized base salary ranges for the primary location and any additional locations are listed below. Workday pay ranges vary based on work location. As a part of the total compensation package, this role may be eligible for the Workday Bonus Plan or a role-specific commission/bonus, as well as annual refresh stock grants. Recruiters can share more detail during the hiring process. Each candidate’s compensation offer will be based on multiple factors including, but not limited to, geography, experience, skills, job duties, and business need, among other things. For more information regarding Workday’s comprehensive benefits, please click here.

Primary Location: USA.VA.Reston


Primary Location Base Pay Range: $163,800 USD - $245,800 USD


Additional US Location(s) Base Pay Range: $148,200 USD - $264,000 USD



Our Approach to Flexible Work

With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.

title: Principal BI Engineer
description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!

Our Values

Best Life

We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.

Growth Mindset

We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.

One Team

From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.





What You'll Do

  • Architect, build, and improve enterprise reporting solutions, including dashboards, semantic models, data transformations, embedded analytics, and reusable reporting assets.

  • Design scalable Power BI semantic layers using dimensional modeling, governed metrics, reusable business logic, and performance-conscious modeling practices.

  • Build and optimize reporting logic using SQL, DAX, Power Query, views, stored procedures, and cloud-based data-processing patterns.

  • Work across Azure, Azure Synapse, Power BI, AWS, and related data platforms to deliver secure, reliable, and scalable reporting solutions.

  • Establish reporting engineering standards for source control, testing, documentation, release management, monitoring, and production readiness.

  • Improve reporting reliability through validation checks, source-to-report reconciliation, refresh monitoring, regression testing, and operational runbooks.

  • Partner across Product, Engineering, Data Engineering, Security, QA, and business teams to translate reporting needs into scalable analytics solutions.

  • Mentor engineers and analysts by sharing patterns, reviewing designs, creating reference implementations, and helping teams adopt consistent reporting practices.

What You'll Need

  • 8+ years of experience architecting and delivering reporting, BI, analytics engineering, enterprise data, or cloud data platform solutions.

  • Deep hands-on experience with Power BI, including Power BI Desktop, Power BI Service, DAX, Power Query, semantic models, refresh management, security, and performance optimization.

  • Experience working with Azure, Azure Synapse, Power BI, AWS, and modern cloud-based data environments.

  • Strong SQL skills, including experience designing and optimizing complex queries, views, stored procedures, transformations, and reconciliation logic.

  • Strong understanding of dimensional modeling, star schemas, semantic-layer design, data warehousing, lakehouse concepts, and governed business metrics.

  • Experience building dashboards, paginated reports, embedded analytics, shared semantic models, or customer-specific reporting solutions.

  • Familiarity with engineering practices such as Git-based source control, peer review, CI/CD, automated deployments, and environment management.

  • Proven ability to troubleshoot complex production reporting issues involving data accuracy, refresh failures, business logic, security, performance, or platform capacity.

And It's Great to Have

  • Experience with Databricks or similar lakehouse platforms.

  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Power BI Embedded, or advanced Azure analytics services.

  • Experience with Tabular Editor, DAX Studio, Power BI Performance Analyzer, deployment pipelines, or related performance and modeling tools.

  • Experience designing multi-tenant, customer-specific, or embedded reporting solutions at enterprise scale.

  • Experience using Python, PowerShell, APIs, orchestration tools, copilots, or AI-assisted workflows to automate reporting engineering processes.

What Success Looks Like

  • ABC's reporting solutions follow scalable, consistent patterns that support growing data volumes, customer needs, and analytical workloads.

  • Power BI models, reports, refreshes, and data flows are reliable, measurable, debuggable, and production-ready.

  • Teams move faster because reusable models, templates, documentation, and validation checks reduce repeated manual work.

  • Reporting engineering practices become more consistent across teams through standards, reference implementations, mentoring, and practical enablement.

  • Stakeholders have greater confidence in the accuracy, performance, usability, and reliability of ABC's reporting solutions.





WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:

  • Purpose led company with a Values focused culture – Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset

  • Time Off – competitive PTO plans with 15 Earned accrued leave, 12 days Sick leave, and 12 days Casual leave per year

  • 11 Holidays plus 4 Days of Disconnect – once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. #oneteam

  • Group Mediclaim insurance coverage of INR 500,000 for employee + spouse, 2 kids, and parents or parent-in-laws, and including EAP counseling

  • Life Insurance and Personal Accident Insurance

  • Best Life Perk – we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement

  • Premium Calm App – enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16

  • Support for working women with financial aid towards crèche facility, ensuring a safe and nurturing environment for their little ones while they focus on their careers

At ABC Fitness, we don’t just build technology—we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. We welcome diverse talent and encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.

ABC’S COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUALITY, BELONGING AND INCLUSION: ABC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strive to create a workplace where every employee, client, and partner feels valued, inspired, and empowered to reach their full potential. For us, inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s a business imperative. Learn more at abcfitness.com.

About ABC Fitness

ABC Fitness is the #1 software provider for fitness businesses of any size, all around the world. Supporting 30K clubs, 650K coaches, 40M members, and processing more than $12B in payments every year, ABC Fitness provides scalable, data-driven solutions to simplify club management and engage members and clients.

From personal trainers, boutique studios, and gyms, to international franchise health clubs, ABC Fitness will move your business forward through technology and industry insights. Innovation is at the center of everything we do, across ABC Glofox, ABC Ignite, ABC Trainerize, and ABC Evo. Let's make your fitness vision a seamless reality, together. Learn more at abcfitness.com

title: Klinik for kræftbehandling søger Ambulatorie sygeplejerske
description:
Vil du være med til at opbygge vores nye kræftcenter i Køge

Klinik for kræftbehandling flytter ind i helt nye lokaler 4 oktober 2026, og glæder os til de nye muligheder, der giver endnu bedre patientforløb, samt udvikling indenfor kræftsygeplejen.

Så hvis du brænder for at gøre en forskel for vores kræftpatienter i deres behandlingsforløb og kan du se dig selv i et job, hvor den gode patientkontakt er i højeste fokus? Glæder vi os til at høre fra dig.

Som et nyt tiltag for at komme tætter på vores kræftpatienters bopæl har vi en satellit enhed på Nykøbing F sygehus, hvor vi en gang om ugen giver kemoterapi borgernært, som gør en stor forskel for vores patienters hverdagsliv. Når man er oplært og selvstændigt kan varetage kemoterapi alt efter kompetencer, kan der være enkelte vagter i Nykøbing.

Ambulatoriet behandler patienter fra hele Region Sjælland med bryst- blære- og prostatakræft samt patienter fra den sydlige del af regionen med Lungekræft. Vi har ca. 34.000 besøg årligt hos læger og sygeplejersker, så vores hverdag er kendetegnet ved et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde. Vi har mange selvstændige sygeplejekonsultationer både ved fremmøde og pr. telefon. Ambulatoriet deltager i flere forskningsprojekter, og har et tæt samarbejde med vores kliniske forskningsenhed. Mamma-teamet sygeplejersker underviser på de patientskoler der tilbydes.

Vi er opdelt i to speciale-teams, bestående af et lunge-/urologisk team og et Mamma-team. Mamma-teamet er et stort team som derfor består af to sygeplejegrupper. Læger og lægesekretærer er ligeledes opdelt i disse teams. Vi lægger vægt på et godt samarbejde på tværs af faggrupper, og med de onkologiske senge/palliative afsnit samt stråleterapien.

Vi er 34 sygeplejersker, som i samråd med lægerne behandler patienter i alle faser af sygdomsforløbet. Behandlingerne omfatter primært medicinsk behandling med kurativt eller palliativt sigte. Sygeplejen i ambulatoriet er kompleks, med mange langvarige kontakter. Vores forløb bygger på Person-Centeret-Praksis som teoretisk referenceramme og fælles beslutningstagen som beslutningsstøtteredskab. Vi uddanner sygeplejestuderende som også er en vigtig del af hverdagen i ambulatoriet.

Vores forventninger til vores kollega/sygeplejerske

  • En sygeplejerske som kan arbejde med alvorlig syge patienter og deres pårørende, og finder det naturligt at finde løsninger med afsæt i patienternes livsverden
  • Vi søger en sygeplejerske der er optaget af at arbejde for det gode arbejdsmiljø, samt besidder gode sociale- og kommunikative kompetencer til at indgå i vores team
  • At du finder det spændende og attraktivt at blive udfordret af blandende arbejdsopgaver, som dagligdagen i et ambulatorium byder på, og du trives i et travlt miljø, kendetegnet af mange relevante afbrydelser, som du skal kunne navigere og bevare roen i
  • Du vil indgå i mange samarbejdsrelationer, hvor det er vigtigt du er imødekommende, har let til smil og overskud til aktivt at bidrage til det gode arbejdsmiljø
  • Du skal være forandringsparat og kunne lide at implementere nye arbejdsgange og tilegne dig ny viden om nye behandlinger
  • Det er et krav at du har kursus i medicinsk kræftbehandling, eller tager det inden for de første seks måneder af ansættelsen (32 timers fjernstudie)
  • Arbejde hver 5 uge en lørdags vagt i eget afsnit.

Vi kan tilbyde

  • En arbejdsplads med høj aktivitet, høj faglighed og et højt ambitionsniveau for at udvikle sygeplejen, hvor vi forventer du aktivt deltager med at udvikle sygeplejen.
  • Vi arbejder aktivt med vores patienttilfredshed og forbedring i patientforløbet. Patienterne får tildelt en kontaktsygeplejerske, som i høj grad er medvirkende til et kontinuererigt patientforløb
  • God introduktion og oplæring tilpasset dine erfaringer og kompetenceniveau. Vi arbejder med onboarding, som betyder at du tilknyttes en erfaren sygeplejefaglig mentor, og dit kompetenceudviklingsforløb følges op ved løbende udviklingssamtaler i gennem det første år.
  • En engageret og dygtig personalegruppe, hvoraf de fleste har mange års erfaring i specialet. Vi har en god kultur for faglig sparring uanset, hvor længe man har været ansat i ambulatoriet
  • Vi har undervisning hver torsdag kl. 8-9 og derudover faglig sparring i eget team
  • Alle sygeplejersker har mulighed for fleksible arbejdstider, som betyder at du har mulighed for medindflydelse på planlægning af din vagtplan.
  • Vi prioriterer kompetenceudvikling højt i afdelingen. Vi har sygeplejersker under uddannelse både til erhvervskandidat og specialuddannelse i kræftsygepleje, samt mange kursus muligheder
  • Vi har etablere flere hjemmearbejdspladser, både med callcenter funktion, og sygepleje ledet ambulatorier som video konsultationer
  • Stort fokus på Work-life-balance, samt det gode arbejdsmiljø og trivsel, vi har det rigtigt godt både fagligt og socialt sammen, og prioritere det sociale samvær meget højt
  • Følg os evt. på Instagram Og LinkedIn, Onkologisk Afdeling Palliativ Enhed, SUH

Ambulatoriet holder åbent mandag-torsdag kl. 7.30-18.00 fredag kl. 7.30-16 og lørdag kl. 8-16 samt enkelte/helligdage ved spidsbelastninger

Position Highlights

This Research Associate will support the Avera Research Institute scientists in a variety of ways and throughout all stages of the research process from proposal writing to dissemination of findings. Given the funding portfolio of Avera Research Institute, this position will be working closely with team members on a variety of maternal health focused projects, helping to evaluate and demonstrate the impact of innovative care pathways, programing and training efforts.

Learn more about the Avera Research Institute at the link below:

Avera Research Institute


You Belong at Avera

Be part of a multidisciplinary team built with compassion and the goal of Moving Health Forward for you and our patients. Work where you matter.


A Brief Overview

Works with principal investigators under general direction to perform professional-level medical or scientific research tasks related to a particular or specialized field of endeavor. These scientific activities including writing literature reviews; contributing to scientific articles, reports and presentations; preparing materials for submission to agencies or boards; summarizing project results; and project implementation and management. This position requires strong written and verbal communication skills, attention to detail and collegiality.

What you will do

  • Assists scientists in the conduct of research, which may include, but are not limited to preparing routine correspondence with various outside parties, scheduling and facilitating project-related meetings, collecting, recording, filing and submitting data according to research protocol.
  • Reviews recommendations by Principal Investigators, students, or other staff of new or modified procedures and protocols prior to implementation to assure appropriateness.
  • Provides periodic small group lectures to research personnel on select topics in research to acquaint them with community-based research and related project topics.
  • Conducts literature searches for Principal Investigator to be used for writing manuscripts and grants or for developing new research studies.
  • Compiles data for statistical analysis and assists in the design and maintenance of databases, spreadsheets, and other computer files used in the administration of research.
  • Writes background and methods sections of grants, reports, and publications for Principal Investigators and other professional personnel.

Essential Qualifications

The individual must be able to work the hours specified. To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential job function satisfactorily including having visual acuity adequate to perform position duties and the ability to communicate effectively with others, hear, understand and distinguish speech and other sounds. These requirements and those listed above are representative of the knowledge, skills, and abilities required to perform the essential job functions. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential job functions, as long as the accommodations do not cause undue hardship to the employer.

Required Education, License/Certification, or Work Experience:

  • Master's in a health or social-related field
  • Scientific writing and/or conducting literature reviews

Preferred Education, License/Certification, or Work Experience:

  • Reference management software
  • Research project management and report generation

Expectations and Standards

  • Commitment to the daily application of Avera’s mission, vision, core values, and social principles to serve patients, their families, and our community.
  • Promote Avera’s values of compassion, hospitality, and stewardship.
  • Uphold Avera’s standards of Communication, Attitude, Responsiveness, and Engagement (CARE) with enthusiasm and sincerity.
  • Maintain confidentiality.
  • Work effectively in a team environment, coordinating work flow with other team members and ensuring a productive and efficient environment.
  • Comply with safety principles, laws, regulations, and standards associated with, but not limited to, CMS, The Joint Commission, DHHS, and OSHA if applicable.

Benefits You Need & Then Some

Avera is proud to offer a wide range of benefits to qualifying part-time and full-time employees. We support you with opportunities to help live balanced, healthy lives. Benefits are designed to meet needs of today and into the future.

  • PTO available day 1 for eligible hires.

title: Cloud DevOps Engineer (Azure)
description:
Chi Siamo

Dev4Side è una software house e system integrator specializzata in soluzioni cloud su Microsoft Azure. Il nostro team Infrastructure & Security progetta, automatizza e mantiene infrastrutture cloud per clienti enterprise, con un forte focus su Infrastructure as Code, sicurezza e affidabilità operativa.

Realizziamo:

  • Sviluppi software per importanti clienti internazionali:
  • Digital workplace con la nostra proposta verticale:

Chi Cerchiamo

Cerchiamo un/una Cloud DevOps Engineer che entri nel team Infrastructure & Security per occuparsi della progettazione e automazione di infrastrutture Azure, delle pipeline CI/CD su Azure DevOps e dello scripting di automazione in PowerShell. È una posizione tecnica e operativa: lavorerai su ambienti reali di clienti enterprise, gestendo richieste di change strutturate e contribuendo all’evoluzione della nostra piattaforma cloud.

Lavorerai a stretto contatto con architetti e specialisti di sicurezza, con margini concreti di crescita verso ruoli di maggiore seniority e ownership architetturale.

Di cosa ti occuperai?

  • Progettare e mantenere infrastruttura Azure in Infrastructure as Code (Bicep / ARM), gestendo RBAC, Managed Identity e Azure Key Vault.
  • Costruire e ottimizzare pipeline CI/CD su Azure DevOps (YAML), inclusi template riusabili, Managed DevOps Pools e gestione di permessi e sicurezza dell’organizzazione.
  • Sviluppare script di automazione in PowerShell con i moduli Az (gestione certificati, App Registration, runbook, Automation Account e Hybrid Worker).
  • Gestire risorse Azure di supporto alle applicazioni: App Service, Function App, Container Registry, SQL Managed Instance.
  • Documentare architetture e procedure, e gestire il ciclo di vita delle change (ServiceNow + Jira) all’interno di un workflow strutturato.

Perchè lavorare in Dev4Side?

  • Organico giovane con forti competenze tecniche
  • Ci piace fare software e ci teniamo a farlo bene, usando gli strumenti giusti per ogni tipo di progetto
  • Investiamo sulle nuove tecnologie e lavoriamo su progetti moderni ed interessanti
  • Per noi una sana Cultura Aziendale è alla base del nostro rapporto lavorativo
  • Si lavora in modalità ibrida. Offrendo la flessibilità di lavorare da casa o dall’ufficio in base alle esigenze di ciascuno, per creare un team composto di persone e non solamente di risorse.
  • Piano di formazione continua con supporto alle certificazioni Microsoft
  • Percorso di crescita strutturato verso ruoli senior / architect

Il nostro candidato ideale ha:

  • Esperienza solida (indicativamente 1-2 anni) su infrastruttura Microsoft Azure.
  • Azure DevOps e CI/CD – capacità nella gestione di pipeline, preferibilmente in YAML.
  • PowerShell con moduli Az – capacità di scrivere script di automazione affidabili e manutenibili.
  • Azure Infrastructure as Code – Bicep o ARM, idealmente con buona padronanza di RBAC e Key Vault.
  • Consapevolezza in materia di sicurezza e governance nell’uso dell’AI (dati sensibili, credenziali) unita a capacità di integrazione nei processi di team in modo trasparente e ripetibile.
  • Capacità di lavorare in autonomia su task strutturati, documentando il proprio lavoro.
  • Buona conoscenza dell’italiano e dell’inglese tecnico (documentazione, ticket, naming).

Consideriamo un plus:

  • Entra ID / App Registration, Azure AD B2C, gestione permessi SharePoint.
  • Networking e sicurezza Azure: Front Door / WAF, Private Endpoint / VNet, gestione certificati TLS/SSL.
  • Azure APIM, Logic Apps e scenari di integrazione/middleware.
  • Monitoring e troubleshooting con Application Insights (KQL), Dynatrace, Azure Monitor.
  • Esperienza con tooling di security e DevSecOps (Wiz, SonarCloud, Gitleaks).
  • Familiarità con processi di change management (ServiceNow, Jira).

Retribuzione: 28.000 - 34.000 RAL

(esclusi bonus di performance aziendale e benefit accessori).

L’offerta reale verrà determinata in base all’effettivo livello di seniority ed expertise tecnica dimostrata in fase di colloquio.

Equal Opportunity Statement:

La selezione è rivolta ai candidati dell’uno e dell’altro sesso ai sensi del D. Lgs. 198⁄2006 . Tutte le candidature saranno gestite ai sensi del Regolamento Europeo 2016⁄679 ( c.d. GDPR).

description:
Job Title

Critical Facility Technician--NIGHT SHIFT

Job Description Summary

The Critical Facilities Technician supports the safe, reliable operation of mission-critical data center infrastructure in a 24/7 environment. This role is responsible for monitoring, operating, maintaining, and documenting electrical, mechanical, and building systems across day, swing, and night shifts while following approved procedures, safety standards, and escalation protocols.

Job Description

  • Operate, monitor, and maintain critical electrical and mechanical infrastructure, including UPS systems, generators, switchgear, PDUs, CRAC/CRAH units, and related equipment.
  • Use BMS, EPMS, and DCIM platforms to monitor system performance, identify alarms, and respond promptly to abnormal operating conditions.
  • Complete preventive and corrective maintenance tasks according to approved maintenance schedules, procedures, and documentation requirements.
  • Execute Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Methods of Procedure (MOPs), and Emergency Operating Procedures (EOPs) accurately and consistently.
  • Troubleshoot equipment issues, support incident response, and escalate conditions that may affect uptime, safety, or service continuity.
  • Coordinate and oversee vendor work to confirm activities are completed safely, professionally, and in accordance with approved procedures.
  • Maintain accurate shift logs, equipment readings, maintenance records, and incident documentation.
  • Follow all site safety requirements, including lockout/tagout (LOTO), electrical safety, arc flash, and OSHA-related procedures.
  • Perform routine rounds, inspections, and equipment checks to verify proper operation and identify potential issues before they affect service.
  • Support commissioning, testing, and minor project work as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 2–5 years of experience in data center operations, critical facilities, industrial maintenance, or a related technical environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in a live data center, hospital, utility, manufacturing, or other mission-critical environment.
  • Hands-on experience with UPS systems, generators, switchgear, HVAC equipment, or building automation systems.
  • Certifications such as CDCTP, CDCP, OSHA 10/30, electrical safety, HVAC, or other relevant technical credentials.
  • Experience supporting commissioning, integrated systems testing, or emergency response drills.

Working knowledge of electrical, mechanical, HVAC, and fire/life safety systems used in critical environments.

Ability to use monitoring platforms such as BMS, EPMS, or DCIM to review system status and respond to alerts.

Ability to read and interpret basic electrical one-line diagrams, equipment manuals, and technical procedures.

Strong troubleshooting, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Familiarity with applicable safety and industry standards, including NFPA, NEC,

OSHA, and site-specific procedures.

Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a shift-based operations environment.

Willingness and ability to work day, swing, or night shifts, including weekends, holidays, and overtime as needed.

Relevant technical training, trade experience, military experience, or equivalent hands-on experience in facilities operations.

title: Mechanical Technician – We Will Train You
description:
Are You Good at Fixing Things?

Royalton, VT | $26–$36/hr + Guaranteed Overtime

You may be qualified for a technical career you've never considered.

I'm looking for mechanically inclined people in and around Central Vermont who are good at figuring out how things work — and why they aren't working.

You do not need injection molding experience.

You might currently work as a:

  • Auto or diesel mechanic
  • HVAC technician
  • CNC or machine operator
  • Maintenance technician
  • Equipment technician
  • Field service technician
  • Installer
  • Electrical or mechanical technician
  • Production or manufacturing operator
  • Heavy equipment technician

Or maybe your job title doesn't fit neatly into any of those categories.

That's okay.

What matters is whether you're mechanically inclined, comfortable around equipment, good at troubleshooting problems, and interested in learning something new.

Not Sure Your Skills Transfer?

Don't automatically rule yourself out — and don't worry about a résumé yet.

Great Bay Staffing created a short Skills Transfer Review specifically for people who have mechanical or technical experience but have never worked in injection molding.

Tell us what you do now, what equipment you work with, and the kinds of problems you troubleshoot. We'll personally review your experience to determine whether the skills you already have could transfer into this opportunity.

Start your Skills Transfer Review here:

No résumé required. It's not a job application.

What Could You Move Into?

I'm recruiting for a Process Technician position with an established precision manufacturing and injection molding company in Royalton, Vermont.

Process Technicians work with sophisticated manufacturing equipment and automated systems. They troubleshoot mechanical and production problems, make adjustments, perform equipment and job setups, monitor quality, and help keep production running properly.

The manufacturing process can be taught. Mechanical aptitude is much harder to teach.

That's why I'm interested in talking to people outside the industry.

What Does It Pay?

$26–$36/hour depending on your experience and transferable skills.

The schedule includes 8 hours of guaranteed overtime each week at time-and-a-half.

At $30/hour, for example, that works out to approximately $81,000/year based on the regular 48-hour schedule.

Benefits include:

  • Medical, dental and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Life insurance
  • Training and cross-training
  • Opportunities to advance into higher-level technical positions

The Schedule

These are 12-hour night shifts on a rotating 3/4-day schedule.

B Shift: Sunday–Tuesday + every other Wednesday, 6PM–6AM

D Shift: Thursday–Saturday + every other Wednesday, 6PM–6AM

That schedule isn't for everybody — and I'm not going to pretend it is.

But it also means you're working only 3 or 4 days each week while receiving 8 hours of guaranteed weekly overtime.

I'm Not Sure I'm Qualified

That's exactly why I'm running this ad.

Don't disqualify yourself because you've never worked in injection molding.

If you work with machines, vehicles, equipment, tools, mechanical systems, or automated equipment and you're good at troubleshooting problems, let us determine whether your experience could transfer.

You have two options:

Already interested? Use the Apply Now button on this posting.

Not sure you're qualified? Complete the Great Bay Staffing Skills Transfer Review:

No résumé required for the review. Not a job application. Just tell us what you know how to do.

11. Assist in receiving and storing food and supplies, ensuring all foods are served at proper temperatures and on time.

12. Assist with any and all aspects of clean-up to ensure all dining service areas are maintained in accordance with policies and standards by completing daily cleaning duties, busing tables, sweeping, mopping and vacuuming, washing dishes, removing trash, stocking and storing items correctly and keeping all dining service work areas clean.

Qualifications, Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required.

1. Must have a minimum of 1 year (preferably 2 to 3 years) of waiting in a fine dining or country club venue.

2.Ability to read, understands and follows recipe instructions, diet orders, resident preference cards, and work assignments.

3. This position will show a willingness to perform routine, repetitive tasks with frequent interruptions.

4. Must be patient and tolerant toward staff, residents, and family members.

5. Ability to develop constructive working and interpersonal relationships with colleagues and customers

6. Problem solving and decision making skills

7. Service orientation and excellent organizational skills

8. Active listening and effective communication competencies

9. Must have or be willing to receive a Hepatitis A vaccine if working within St. Louis County (in accordance with County health regulations)

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions

The physical activities and demands described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential job duties and responsibilities.

The Waiter/Waitress stands and walks intermittently throughout the working day, as well as reaches, stoops, bends, lifts, carries, and manipulates various food products, dietary supplies and equipment. The Waiter/Waitress must have an ability to work with chemicals and cleaning agents. Must be able to withstand exposure to temperature and humidity changes as in entering refrigerated storage areas, working at ovens, ranges, dish-washing machines, and at steam tables. This employee must be free from infections or diseases. The employee must have the ability to lift and carry a 27in long tray weighing 20lb from a height of 36 inches and carry a distance of 100ft; walk continuously for ½ mile; push and/or pull a 180lb sled a distance of 20ft requiring 30lbs of force; push a wheelchair with a load of 200lbs for a distance of 100ft; push/pull 30lbs; and perform 1 full squat.

title: Data Infra Team Lead
description:
Zafran is building the next generation of vulnerability and risk management. Our platform brings together security, asset, vulnerability, exposure, and business context from many systems — then turns that data into clear investigation, prioritization, and action.

We’re creating a new Data Infra team to own the investigation infrastructure of Zafran’s data layer for the Platform. This team will take over the infrastructure behind our investigation databases and search capabilities.

Data Infra will own the foundations behind Zafran’s data layer: infrastructure, modeling, performance, reliability, and query capabilities on top of our investigation databases. Other product and engineering teams will build customer-facing experiences, workflows, dashboards, and insights on top of the capabilities this team provides.

We’re looking for an experienced Data Infra Team Lead to build and lead this team — someone who comes from deep data infrastructure, analytical databases, search infrastructure, and large-scale querying, and who wants to shape one of the most important technical foundations of Zafran’s platform.

﻿About Zafran:


Our Mission: To stop the exploitation of vulnerabilities, everywhere.

What makes us different: Zafran de-risks 90% of critical vulnerabilities overnight across your hybrid environment and utilizes Agentic Capabilities and your existing security tools to rapidly mitigate and remediate the 10% most likely to be exploited.

​​Who’s behind us: Zafran is backed by Menlo Ventures, Sequoia Capital, Cyberstarts, and a deep belief that cybersecurity should move as fast as attackers do. We’re one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry, scaling to meet demand from the world’s most advanced, security-obsessed organizations.

We’re serious about our mission- so expect work that matters, teammates who challenge and inspire you, and plenty of fun along the way!

What you’ll do

  • Create, build and lead Zafran’s Data Infra team from the ground up.

  • Own the infrastructure of Zafran’s investigation data layer for the Platform.

  • Turn Zafran’s investigation infrastructure into a dedicated, well-defined platform capability.

  • Design and evolve the data models, schemas, indexing strategies, and query patterns that power Zafran’s investigation databases.

  • Lead the architecture, operation, and scaling of the databases and search infrastructure that power investigation, analytics, and query use cases across the platform.

  • Partner closely with Product, Backend, DevOps, Security Research, and customer-facing engineering teams to define clear boundaries, contracts, and data-layer APIs.

  • Make the data layer reliable, observable, cost-efficient, and performant across many tenants and large volumes of security data.

  • Set engineering standards for schema design, data modeling, query optimization, migrations, backfills, and data-quality monitoring.

  • Mentor engineers, review technical designs, and raise the bar for how Zafran builds and operates data infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on: this is a leadership role for someone who can still go deep into architecture, production issues, performance bottlenecks, and complex queries.

What we’re looking for

  • Experience leading engineers or acting as a technical lead in a data infrastructure, platform, backend infrastructure, or database-oriented team.

  • Strong hands-on background with large-scale analytical databases, data platforms, or search infrastructure.

  • Deep understanding of data modeling, query optimization, indexing, partitioning, storage layouts, and performance tradeoffs.

  • Production experience with ClickHouse, Elasticsearch, or similar technologies such as BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, OpenSearch, or other analytical/search systems.

  • Strong backend engineering fundamentals and the ability to design systems that are reliable, scalable, observable, and maintainable.

  • Experience operating data systems in production: monitoring, incident response, capacity planning, cost management, migrations, and backfills.

  • Ability to define clean interfaces between platform infrastructure teams and product/application teams.

  • A leadership style that combines technical depth, ownership, mentorship, and strong cross-team collaboration.

  • Comfort working in a fast-moving startup environment where the team is still being shaped and the technical foundations are evolving.

Nice to have

  • Hands-on ClickHouse experience in production.

  • Hands-on ElasticSearch experience in production.

  • Experience with multi-tenant SaaS data architectures.

  • Experience with streaming or event-driven ingestion pipelines, including Kafka or similar technologies.

  • Background in cybersecurity, vulnerability management, exposure management, CTEM, SIEM, EDR, CNAPP, CSPM, or related security-data domains.

  • Experience building a new team, owning a platform capability, or extracting infrastructure ownership from a product team.

  • Experience supporting analytical or investigation-heavy product use cases.

Why this role matters

Zafran’s product depends on making complex security data usable, searchable, explainable, and actionable. The Data Infra team will own the technical layer that makes this possible.

This is a chance to define how Zafran models and queries investigation data, how our product teams consume it, and how our platform scales as customer data grows. You’ll be joining at the moment where the data layer becomes a dedicated platform discipline — and you’ll have the opportunity to shape both the architecture and the team behind it.

title: Senior AI Forward Deployed Engineer - Cogentiq I2C
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Senior AI Forward Deployed Engineer - Cogentiq I2C (Invoice-to-Cash)

Role summary

You own the technical success of Cogentiq I2C at a portfolio of strategic accounts. You take a business problem that arrives stated in finance terms, reduce our days sales outstanding, stop writing off small-balance deductions, and turn it into a production AI system that the customer’s finance organisation actually uses.

You lead a small deployment team. You make the architecture calls. You are the person the customer sponsor calls when something is wrong, and the person who tells them what we will not build. This is an engineering role. You will still be in the codebase. The difference from the first band is that you also carry the account, the design and the team.

What you will own

Account technical ownership

  • Own the technical outcome for a portfolio of accounts, from discovery through production rollout and scale.
  • Set and defend the deployment KPI contract: accuracy, straight-through processing rate, latency, cost per transaction, adoption and business impact.
  • Hold the technical relationship with customer sponsors and IT leadership.

Solution design and architecture

  • Translate ambiguous goals into a solution design covering agent topology, retrieval strategy, human oversight boundaries, integration approach and data model.
  • Make and document the build versus configure versus extend-the-product calls. Decline bespoke work that cannot be maintained across the customer base.
  • Own the integration design against customer ERP, banking and document infrastructure.

Delivery leadership

  • Lead a deployment team of Forward Deployed Engineers and specialists. Scope the work, sequence it and unblock it.
  • Own proof-of-value and pilot scoping, including effort estimates and success criteria that can be measured rather than asserted.
  • Act as incident commander for production failures. Own the root cause analysis and the remediation plan.

Advisory

  • Explain to finance and IT leadership what the system can and cannot do and what residual risk remains after it is deployed.
  • Guide customers on governance, human oversight design, model risk and responsible AI.

Product and asset leadership

  • Convert deployment learnings into reusable assets: reference architectures, connector templates, evaluation packs and deployment accelerators.
  • Bring evidenced feedback to the product roadmap. Distinguish a single customer’s preference from a genuine product gap.

What you bring

  • 6 to 10 years building and operating production systems, including at least two years in customer-facing delivery.
  • A track record of taking at least one non-trivial AI system to production and keeping it running afterwards.
  • Strong Python and system design depth.
  • Depth across LLM and agentic architectures, retrieval, evaluation methodology, guardrails and observability.
  • Cloud deployment experience at scale. Azure is preferred given our stack. Containers and orchestration.
  • Enough finance vocabulary to hold a conversation about DSO, deductions, remittance advice, and cash application without a translator or the evident ability to get there within a quarter.
  • Commercial judgement. You can recognise when a customer request has quietly become unpaid scope, and you raise it early.
  • Willingness to travel and embed with customers.

Nice to have

  • AI deployments in regulated industries.
  • Enterprise ERP integration experience, particularly SAP S/4HANA or Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations.
  • Experience mentoring or leading engineers.
  • Pre-sales or solution architecture exposure.
  • Startup or product-building experience where customer feedback shaped what got built.

What success looks like in your first year

  • Two accounts running in production against agreed KPIs.
  • The Forward Deployed Engineers on your team are measurably more capable than when they joined it.
  • At least two reusable assets you produced are in use by another deployment team.

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

Not the right fit? Let us know you're interested in a future opportunity by clicking Introduce Yourself in the top-right corner of the page or create an account to set up email alerts as new job postings become available that meet your interest!

description:
WHAT IS THE JOB ?

As a Dishwasher Leader, you will be tasked with overseeing all aspects of dishwashing operations within the kitchen environment. Your role involves maintaining cleanliness, organizing tasks efficiently, and leading a team to ensure seamless functioning of the dishwashing area.

Tasks and Responsibilities – Dishpit Leader

  • Supervise, train, and support dishwashing staff to ensure efficient daily operations.
  • Assign tasks and monitor performance to maintain cleanliness, sanitation, and productivity standards.
  • Ensure all dishware, glassware, cookware, and kitchen equipment are properly cleaned, sanitized, and available for service.
  • Oversee daily, weekly, and scheduled cleaning duties in compliance with health, safety, and sanitation standards.
  • Ensure proper use of cleaning products, PPE, and safe work procedures.
  • Maintain cleanliness of dishwashing areas, equipment, waste stations, and storage areas.
  • Coordinate with kitchen and dining room teams to support smooth meal service operations.
  • Ensure adequate supplies of dishes, cutlery, trays, and serving ware are available at all times.
  • Promote a safe work environment by addressing spills, hazards, and sanitation concerns promptly.
  • Assist kitchen staff and support overall food service operations as required.
  • Deliver professional and courteous service to guests and team members at all times.

QUEL EST LE TRAVAIL ?

À titre de Chef de la plonge, vous serez responsable de superviser l’ensemble des opérations de plonge au sein de l’environnement de cuisine. Votre rôle consiste à maintenir un haut niveau de propreté, à organiser efficacement le travail et à diriger une équipe afin d’assurer le bon fonctionnement des activités de plonge.

Tâches et responsabilités

  • Superviser, former et soutenir l’équipe de plonge afin d’assurer le bon déroulement des opérations quotidiennes.
  • Répartir les tâches et assurer le suivi du rendement afin de maintenir des normes élevées de propreté, de salubrité et de productivité.
  • Veiller à ce que toute la vaisselle, la verrerie, les ustensiles de cuisine et les équipements soient correctement lavés, désinfectés et disponibles pour les services.
  • Superviser les tâches d’entretien quotidiennes, hebdomadaires et planifiées conformément aux normes de santé, de sécurité et de salubrité.
  • S’assurer de l’utilisation adéquate des produits de nettoyage, des équipements de protection individuelle (ÉPI) et des méthodes de travail sécuritaires.
  • Maintenir la propreté des aires de plonge, des équipements, des postes de gestion des déchets et des espaces d’entreposage.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes de cuisine et de salle à manger afin de soutenir le bon déroulement des services.
  • Veiller à ce qu’un inventaire suffisant de vaisselle, d’ustensiles, de plateaux et d’articles de service soit toujours disponible.
  • Favoriser un environnement de travail sécuritaire en intervenant rapidement en cas de déversement, de risque ou de problème de salubrité.
  • Apporter son soutien aux équipes de cuisine et aux opérations de restauration selon les besoins.
  • Offrir en tout temps un service professionnel, courtois et respectueux aux clients et aux membres de l’équipe.

  • Minimum 1 year experience in team supervision.

  • Food Safe level one Certificate preferred.

  • Lead by example in promoting a respectful and professional work environment.

  • Strong computer and administrative skills preferred.

Qualifications requises

  • Minimum d’un (1) an d’expérience en supervision d’équipe.
  • Certification Food Safe niveau 1 considérée comme un atout.
  • Capacité à montrer l’exemple en favorisant un environnement de travail respectueux et professionnel.
  • Bonnes compétences informatiques et administratives, un atout.

title: Senior Engineer, DevOps Engineering
description:
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

Coro is Bain's persistent product development and engineering organization, building and operating the firm's proprietary digital solutions. Coro brings together technology, data, and services to create differentiated value for Bain's clients and case teams.

This role sits within Coro's DevOps and Assurance team, part of the Next Generation Software Solutions (NGSS) department. The team enables secure, efficient, and reliable delivery of technology across Bain's global ecosystem, focusing on both technical operations and platform assurance so that every deployment meets the firm's standards for quality, security, and compliance.

WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM

The Senior Engineer helps build and operate the infrastructure, deployment automation, and operational reliability behind Coro's platforms. Working alongside architects and backend engineers, this engineer provisions and operates Azure infrastructure, builds and maintains CI/CD pipelines, and helps ensure services are deployed consistently, monitored effectively, and can scale as the build plan expands.

This is a delivery-focused role: the Senior Engineer executes well against established standards and patterns, takes ownership of the tasks assigned to them, and collaborates closely with the wider team. It is a critical foundational role in the early stages of the platform build, requiring strong technical fundamentals and the pragmatism to make infrastructure decisions that support a fast-moving product team.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Infrastructure & Automation – 30%

  • Design, provision, and manage cloud infrastructure using Terraform and Terraform Cloud. Automate deployments to ensure scalability, consistency, and security across environments.
  • Architect and manage Azure networking: VNet/subnet design, private endpoints, DNS resolution, NSG rules, and Front Door Premium configuration.
  • Provision and maintain Azure platform services: App Services, Azure SQL, Azure OpenAI, Container Registry (e.g. Azure Container Registry, Cloudsmith), Key Vault, Entra ID, and Storage Accounts (ADLS Gen2).
  • Collaborate with Bain's central cloud and infrastructure teams to refine shared processes, tooling, and approaches to operational work.

Cloud & Platform Management (Azure) – 25%

  • Manage Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters, including node pools, scaling, spot instances, and workload connectivity to dependent services (databases, storage, AI services).
  • Manage identity and access: Entra ID app registrations, managed identities, RBAC, and integration with external IdPs (Okta).
  • Administer database platforms from an infrastructure perspective: Azure SQL Serverless, PostgreSQL Flexible Server, Cosmos DB, including connectivity, Entra auth, firewall rules, and private endpoints.
  • Ensure robust access controls and platform reliability across dev, demo, and production environments.

CI/CD & Software Delivery – 20%

  • Build, optimize, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions for container builds, infrastructure deployments, and application releases.
  • Manage container image lifecycle: build, scan, push to a container registry (e.g. Azure Container Registry, Cloudsmith), and deploy to AKS or App Services.
  • Implement environment promotion workflows with appropriate gating, secrets management (Key Vault), and rollback strategies.
  • Design and operate GitHub-hosted private runners where required, including network integration with Azure VNets.

Monitoring, Security & Assurance – 15%

  • Implement and operate observability using the team's monitoring stack (e.g. Datadog, Azure Application Insights). Monitor performance, resolve issues proactively, and optimize cost and reliability.
  • Respond to security findings: triage, containment, IAM scoping, container image CVE remediation, and endpoint hardening.
  • Handle L2/L3 incident escalations, including root-cause analysis, user journey tracing, and log analysis.
  • Enforce solution compliance across products: network isolation, least-privilege access, secrets hygiene, and deployment guardrails.
  • Maintain local development environments and deployment documentation so engineers across the distributed team can onboard quickly and operate with minimal infrastructure friction.

Leadership & Collaboration – 10%

  • Partner with architects, product engineers, and security teams to align on infrastructure standards and platform roadmaps.
  • Promote DevOps culture, automation-first thinking, and continuous improvement across the NGSS engineering organization.
  • Contribute to technical discovery, POCs, and innovation workstreams to validate new tools, technologies, and architectural patterns.
  • Support team recruiting activities: resume screening, technical interviews, and candidate evaluation.

ABOUT YOU

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 4–6 years of experience in DevOps, infrastructure engineering, or cloud platform engineering roles.
  • Proven track record of designing and operating cloud infrastructure in production environments.
  • Demonstrated experience working with cross-functional engineering teams in fast-paced product organizations.

Professional Skills & Mindset

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to translate complex technical topics for diverse stakeholders.
  • Proactive, analytical, and systematic, with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to trace issues across multiple layers (DNS, networking, identity, application).
  • Results-driven with a bias for automation and continuous improvement.
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies and a commitment to team enablement.

Technical Expertise

  • Hands-on experience with Terraform and Terraform Cloud (or equivalent): workspace management, state, modules, and remote backends.
  • Strong proficiency in Azure services, including AKS, Networking (VNets, subnets, private endpoints, NSGs, DNS zones), App Services, Key Vault, Container Registry, and Storage Accounts.
  • Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) and container image lifecycle management.
  • Expertise in roles, permissions, and IAM, particularly Microsoft Entra ID and Okta.
  • Advanced skills in CI/CD automation using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, and related DevOps toolchains.
  • Proficient in Linux administration and automation scripting (Bash, PowerShell, Python) for reusable workflows.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability platforms (e.g. Datadog, Azure Application Insights).
  • Familiarity with Azure private networking: private endpoints (blob, DFS, SQL, PostgreSQL), Private DNS Zones, and VNet integration for App Services and AKS.
  • Competent in database deployment and management from an infrastructure perspective, Azure SQL Serverless, PostgreSQL Flexible Server, and Cosmos DB.
  • Foundation in security remediation: container CVE patching, IAM scoping, NSG/firewall tightening, and WAF/Front Door rule management.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional certifications such as Azure DevOps Engineer Expert, Azure Administrator, Terraform Associate, or CKA (or equivalent).
  • Experience managing multi-environment governance, cost optimization, and compliance frameworks in cloud environments.
  • Familiarity with Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Search, Databricks, and the integration of AI services into enterprise platforms.
  • Experience with workflow orchestration tools (Airflow, or similar DAG/pipeline systems).
  • Snowflake administration or connectivity from a DevOps lens.

Purpose

Required:

  • Proficiency in ERP systems and standard office applications.
  • Effective communication skills in a multi‑disciplinary, multicultural environment.

Preferred:

  • Experience with pressure equipment & piping, mechanical packages, or ASU‑related materials.
  • Familiarity with international sourcing and supplier quality management.
  • Experience working with multinational companies, preferably American or European organizations.
  • Experience working with fabrication shops or manufacturing facilities.

Licenses / Certifications:

  • None

Competencies

  • Demonstrates personal accountability for commitments and results.
  • Collaborates effectively across functions and cultures.
  • Applies sound judgment in technical and commercial decision‑making.
  • Communicates clearly and respectfully with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Actively supports continuous improvement and learning.

Safety & Compliance

  • Comply with all Air Products safety policies, Life Saving Rules, and EHS requirements.
  • Ensure procurement activities meet applicable codes, standards, and regulatory requirements.
  • Promote a strong safety culture when engaging suppliers.
  • Support ethical sourcing and compliance with company procurement policies.

Work Hours

Travel

Assumption: Up to 20–30% domestic travel within China for supplier visits, inspections, and manufacturing support.

Engagement type: Independent Contractor Agreement

Work Schedule: This role is expected to align with the AU business hours (approx. 8 AM - 4 PM, Monday to Friday) for collaboration, but as a contractor, you’ll have flexibility in how you manage your time.

Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is: Our client is an established construction and property development business that brings building projects from concept through completion. With a strong focus on collaboration, quality, and efficient execution, the company delivers tailored solutions across a diverse range of developments.

Driven by continuous improvement and a hands-on approach to project management, the organization values innovation, accountability, and long-term relationships. As the business continues to grow, it is expanding its team with professionals who are committed to delivering exceptional service and high-quality outcomes.

Role Overview: We are looking for an Architectural Draftsmen to join a growing Australian construction team. This role is responsible for producing accurate, high-quality architectural drawings and documentation across various stages of the residential building process; from concept and tender through to building approval and construction.

You will work closely with internal teams, customers, councils, certifiers, engineers, surveyors, and other external consultants to ensure projects are accurately documented, compliant with Australian building requirements, and ready for construction. It is essential that you have over 3 years experience working with Australian businesses designing and updating plans during construction of highrise apartments (minimum 4 storey) and commercial buildings.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design high level architectural drawings to Australian building standards for council design approval and construction purposes
  • Prepare and manage detailed residential drawings, including site, earthworks, retaining, floor, roof, elevations, sections, schedules, facades, kitchens, bathrooms, slabs, electrical, landscape, structural, stormwater, 3D models, and other required documentation.
  • Do a material takeoff of whole projects based on your finished designs and material choices
  • Work out the most cost efficient material choices in areas where materials can vary
  • Work virtually alongside the site manager, project manager and contract administrator to constantly give advice regarding designs, or when required give further details for plans or update drawings
  • Monitor weekly workflow, prioritise tasks, track project progress, and proactively identify and resolve issues affecting deadlines.
  • Produce accurate, high-quality architectural working drawings on time, from initial custom sketches and concept plans through to tender, contract, building approval, DA, and construction documentation.
  • Prepare amended plans and update documentation based on approved variations and project changes.
  • Liaise and coordinate with councils, certifiers, planners, engineers, surveyors, and other external consultants to resolve design requirements and ensure projects are ready for construction.
  • Manage building approval processes, including responding to authority requirements, preparing additional drawings and reports, and assisting with conditions of approval and application issues.
  • Prepare and maintain standard construction details, detail registries, master drawings, facades, and ArchiCAD documentation and library structures.
  • Ensure designs are safe, buildable, and compliant with applicable building codes, regulations, and legal requirements.

title: Data Engineer, Asiakkuuksien liiketoiminta-analytiikka (Helsinki/Oulu)
description:
Oletko taitava datan käsittelijä, joka haluaa rakentaa liiketoimintaa tukevia dataratkaisuja? Kiinnostaako sinua eri datalähteiden hyödyntäminen, datan jalostaminen analytiikan käyttöön sekä skaalautuvien dataputkien ja datatuotteiden kehittäminen? Haluatko olla mukana tukemassa Pohjola Vakuutuksen digikanavien, markkinoinnin ja myynnin kehitystä datan avulla?

Haemme nyt Data Engineeriä vakituiseen ja kokoaikaiseen työsuhteeseen osaksi Asiakkuuksien liiketoiminta-analytiikka -tiimiä. Tehtävä sijaitsee Helsingissä tai Oulussa, riippuen toiveestasi. Kuten muuallakin OP Pohjolassa, yhdistämme arjessamme sekä lähi- että etätyöskentelyä.

Millaisesta tehtävästä on kyse?

Asiakkuuksien liiketoiminta-analytiikka -tiimi hyödyntää dataa vahinkovakuutusliiketoiminnan kehittämisessä ja päätöksenteon tukena. Tiimi rakentaa datatuotteita, analytiikkaratkaisuja ja raportointia, joiden avulla liiketoiminta voi ymmärtää asiakkaiden tarpeita paremmin sekä kehittää asiakaskokemusta.

Data Engineerinä vastaat liiketoiminnan tarvitsemien datatuotteiden, integraatioiden ja dataputkien suunnittelusta, toteutuksesta ja ylläpidosta. Rakennat ratkaisuja, joiden avulla data kulkee luotettavasti eri lähdejärjestelmistä analytiikan ja liiketoiminnan käyttöön sekä on laadukasta, helposti löydettävää ja hyödynnettävää.

Työsi painottuu erityisesti datatuotteiden ja dataputkien kehittämiseen Databricks-ympäristössä moderneja työkaluja ja kehitysmenetelmiä hyödyntäen. Vastaat myös datan laadun varmistamisesta sekä kehität ratkaisuja, joiden avulla analytiikka- ja raportointiratkaisut voivat hyödyntää dataa tehokkaasti ja luotettavasti.

Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä analyytikoiden, liiketoiminnan asiantuntijoiden ja muiden teknologiatiimien kanssa. Tiimi työskentelee läheisesti CRM-, markkinoinnin automaatio- ja contact center -järjestelmien parissa, joten ymmärrys näistä järjestelmistä ja niiden datarakenteista tukee tehtävässä onnistumista.

Työskentelet pilviympäristöissä, joissa hyödynnämme tällä hetkellä sekä AWSää että Azurea, mutta suuntaamme yhä vahvemmin kohti Azurea. Tässä roolissa olet mukana rakentamassa tulevaisuuden pilvipohjaisia datakyvykkyyksiä ja hyödyntämässä uusia teknologioita, mukaan lukien tekoälyn tarjoamia mahdollisuuksia.

Millaista osaamista etsimme sinulta?

Etsimme henkilöä, jolla on kokemusta datan parissa työskentelystä ja kiinnostusta kehittää liiketoimintaa tukevia dataratkaisuja. Voit olla jo kokenut Data Engineer tai ohjelmistokehittäjä, joka haluaa syventyä vahvemmin datan, integraatioiden ja data-alustojen kehittämiseen.

  • Ylempi korkeakoulututkinto tehtävään soveltuvalta alalta
  • Työkokemusta vastaavista tehtävistä
  • Vahvaa Python-osaamista ja kokemusta datan käsittelystä
  • Syvällistä ymmärrystä relaatiotietokannoista, SQLstä ja tietovarastointijärjestelmistä
  • Kokemusta pilvialustoista, kuten Azuresta tai AWSstä
  • Ymmärrystä ETL-ratkaisuista, kuten Azure Data Factorysta ja Databricksistä
  • Vahvaa osaamista skaalautuvien ja kestävien data pipeline -ratkaisujen suunnittelusta ja toteutuksesta sekä erä- että suoratoistokäsittelyssä
  • Vahvaa kehitystaustaa ja sitoutumista ammatillisiin ohjelmointikäytäntöihin, kuten koodin luettavuuden, modulaarisuuden ja muiden parhaiden käytäntöjen edistämiseen ja noudattamiseen
  • Hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja suomeksi ja englanniksi
  • Kykyä kommunikoida teknisiä ja monimutkaisiakin asioita sidosryhmille selkeästi ja ymmärrettävästi

Emme odota sinulta kokemusta jokaisesta yllä mainitusta osaamisalueesta. Arvostamme monipuolista teknistä taustaa ja kokemusta vastaavanlaisista tehtävistä, mutta ennen kaikkea toivomme sinulta halua oppia uutta ja kehittyä Data Engineerina. Keskeistä on kyky omaksua uusia teknologioita ja ottaa haltuun tehtävän kokonaisuus.

Menestyäksesi tehtävässä sinulla on hyvä itseohjautuvuus ja kyky suunnitella sekä priorisoida omaa työtäsi. Toimit luontevasti yhteistyössä tiimin ja eri sidosryhmien kanssa sekä haluat jakaa osaamistasi myös muille. Arvostamme aktiivista ja ratkaisukeskeistä työskentelyotetta sekä halua kehittää yhteisiä toimintatapoja. Asiakasanalytiikan sekä CRM-, markkinoinnin automaatio- ja contact center -järjestelmien tuntemus katsotaan eduksi.

Miksi OP Pohjola?

Liittymällä joukkoomme pääset osaksi OP Pohjolan Kehittäminen ja teknologiat -organisaatiota. Organisaatiomme kehittää digitaalisia palveluita ja järjestelmiä asiakkailleen sekä omalle henkilöstölleen. Olemme vastuussa OP Pohjolan ICT-strategiasta, teknologialinjauksista, arkkitehtuurista, yhteisistä alustoista, infrastruktuurista, jatkuvuudenhallinnasta sekä koko ryhmän kyberturvallisuudesta. Alueella työskentelee yhteensä 5000 omaa ja kumppaneidemme IT-ammattilaista.

Elämä on kuitenkin paljon muutakin kuin työtä. Meille on tärkeää, että työ ja vapaa-aika kulkevat rinnakkain, ja työnantajana olemme valmiita joustamaan elämän eri tilanteissa.

Saat käyttöösi monipuoliset henkilöstöetumme, johon kuuluvat mm. henkilökuntaehtoiset pankki-, vakuutus- ja lainapalvelut. Tarjoamme myös kattavan työterveyshuollon, laajan hoitokuluvakuutuksen sekä täysajan tapaturmavakuutuksen. Työssäjaksamiseen panostamme arjen tasapainolla ja joustavuudella sekä tarjoamalla käyttöösi lounas-, liikunta- ja kulttuuriedut sekä mahdollisuuden edulliseen lomailuun OP Pohjolan lomaosakkeissa.

Kiinnostuitko?

Hae tehtävään viimeistään sunnuntaina 6.9.2026.

OP Pohjola – Meillä on jotain yhteistä

OP Pohjola on monimuotoisuutta ja yhdenvertaisuutta kunnioittava työyhteisö. Meille on tärkeää, että jokainen tuntee olonsa tervetulleeksi ja arvostetuksi. Arvostamme erilaisuuden mukanaan tuomaa rikkautta ja monipuolisia näkökulmia. Kannustamme kaikkia hakemaan meille töihin, sillä meillä on jotain yhteistä. Hienoa, että haluat mukana yhteiselle matkallemme.

Olemme asiakkaidemme omistama, finanssialan vetovoimaisin työnantaja Suomessa. Meillä työskentelee yli 14 000 alan ammattilaista. Perustehtävämme on edistää omistaja-asiakkaidemme ja toimintaympäristömme kestävää taloudellista menestystä, turvallisuutta ja hyvinvointia. Meillä työskentely on merkityksellistä sekä työntekijöillemme että muille, sillä Suomen suurimpana finanssitoimijana rakennamme työllämme toiveikkaampaa tulevaisuutta. Sitä olemme tehneet jo yli 120 vuoden ajan.

Finanssialalla luottamus ja vastuullisuus ovat toimintamme perusta, minkä vuoksi tehtävään valittavalta henkilöltä tarkistetaan luottotiedot, yritysyhteydet ja mahdolliset eturistiriidat, teetetään huumausainetesti sekä Suojelupoliisin teettämä perusmuotoinen turvallisuusselvitys.
